text: As immersive as you allow it to be. The framework of the game is very outdated, but it gets the job done. Still a lot to be desired (better achievement system would be a great start), but I'm afraid a new game would have to be created to get a much better experience. Addictive, gets you out, gets you walking/running, and there are people playing it almost everywhere if you want to socialize. Amazing game.

Still a really fun (and addicting) game with more to do than ever. We all know what this game is at this point, so I'm not going to go into all the stuff you can do. However, I'm taking a star off for two reasons. One, after all this time, they still never solved the issue of the game never reconnecting if you lose your connection in the middle of catching a pokémon. And two, some features aren't well explained and involve far too much messing around to try to figure them out.

Events are out of control now. They all last way too long because they all use a tedious battle pass model with bland rewards that you have to work too hard for. What happened to Timed Research that I could complete in a couple of days? Or events that lasted for a couple of days for that matter? Stop trying to force me to play like the hardcore players and let me do my own thing! Don't hold event rewards at ransom! Apparently my location data isn't enough!

Please fix the lags that are happening since the latest update. The app continually crashes, freezes, lags, and is generally unstable since the biomes were released. Pretty much every aspect of the game has been affected; catching, trading, opening/sending gifts, raiding, GBL... it's all unstable and it's making it less fun to play. Less fun for players means less playing - which equate to less money for y'all.

Bait and switch tactics. Bait purchases with rewards they cannot deliver on when "multiple different stops or gyms" are a requirement for special research. Remote players (I.E. Arctic Coast) are unable to complete special research for rewards specified in descriptions. They fail to disclose requirements beforehand, and will not refund purchase OR allow exceptions for research.

Only tried this for pokémon champions! iyky This game would be awesome if it wasn't made to revolve around microtransactions. barely any bag space, not much space for pokemon either, and from what I've seen you can only buy pokeballs with gold if you run out. it's not like you're earning some sort of currency for beating gyms or team rocket grunts that you can use to buy different pokeballs, potions, ect. No that would make too much sense and make them less money. I don't recommend this game

I have played this game since release, and it has changed a lot. Now, you need to pay to play the game. One main thing I dislike is the fact that only one free raid is available every day. Players who pay in the game get so many perks and its expensive. Playing against those players is very unfair. Although most of the game is locked behind a paywall, its still fun, but older versions were better. Oh yeah and it lags a lot sometimes. Including odds, and the game is just a casino in the end.

I think this game is great. Because it is a fun way to connect with people and, pass the time. I like how there are friendship levels and, that you have to send gifts or battle with or against them to raise your friendship level I also think it is smart that it only goes up one point a day to keep players coming back on the game. The mechanics of the game are great but I think they can also improve the graphics of the game and improve the stitching of the Pokémon and blend the colors better. 👍

Customer service not paying attention to what I said, incorrectly correcting me, and what they are proposing won't solve my problem. There's a glitch where it won't let you catch your Pokémon on rewards. The first one, I "ran" and it sat there in rewards. After months of it being glitched it was finally successful. I forgot about it into now. It happened again, twice. One when I ran is still sitting for me to capture. The other when I "ran" it continued the quest. I lost my Mew. Support is bad

I just started playing this a week or two ago and was really getting into it pretty good I like the game however when I turn level 25 I was supposed to get several items for leveling up and that didn't happen I got a couple of the items but not all of them. i contacted support told them what was missing which was 15 ultra balls and 15 max revives Even had screenshot proof that they were not in my inventory. to be honest The other items I really wasn't worried ab so Idk if I got them or not.

I have been playing since 2016 and really love the game. I miss the old "Special Research" though. It allowed players to get the new releases without pressure to complete it in 5 days. It really helped when we were playing with children because they would get excited to get through the tasks too, but it definitely took them longer. Please bring this back! The game was so much more enjoyable!

I've been playing since day one. It was fun in the beginning and peaked during covid when it was easier to play. Game is glitchy now. Niantic and now scopely continues to make this game more and more unplayable. The weather is horrible outside in most places and now they expect us to search for Giovanni at PokeStops. No real quality of life updates that actually help disabled and rural players. Plus, making it impossible to get new pokestops and routes in areas. Finding it harder to play this.

Very fun game. i love the events, but I wish there weren't so many little ones, so I don't always feel like I'm missing out on something if I can't play, but the biggest issue of all is that the game is pretty much pay to win so if they could just fix that PLEASE or at least make it a little easier to get free coins than I would definitely give this a 5*

I really like this game! Though, it sucks for some people, like me as well! the game needs internet to play, but not everyone has that. So it is hard to go to Pokéstops or move around to evolve certain pokemon. Overall, it is super fun! but I wish you could chat with friends, especially with trading. And maybe have more pokemon spawn in diffrent places instead of the same ones every time. But, overall, it's not a half bad game! would recommend besides the small flaws

If it were up to just the fun of the game, this would get a solid 5, if not 6 stars! But the customer support that they have is not good at all. They will not do a thing to help except just tell you the same information. Also, its pretty glitchy, and I lost access to my campfire app. All in All amazing game, highly recommend to anyone who's thinking about getting it, just don't go to customer support if you need something because they won't help you.

Frequent glitches, knocked out of raids randomly with no chance to catch (which wastes raid passes I've paid for), and WAY too many updates. Constantly required or you can't play, taking up time and storage on my phone. It's all really ridiculous and takes the fun out of the game. Super disappointing. And also, as others have mentioned, the Rewards that you can't even access on the website.

The game is absolutely fantastic, but not quite perfect just yet. I have a few criticisms: 1. Please add a dark mode option. No reason for there not to be one this far into the game's life. 2. Remove the daily coin limit. Why is that a thing? The amount of coins I get should be proportional to the time my Pokémon were in a gym. 3. Better hair and face customization. I want my messy bun. 4. A new non-battle focused game mode. Maybe some mini games to play with your buddy pokemon and friends.

I have not spent a dime since the price increases and will not anymore. I continue to play because I've invested so much in the game but I'll no longer spend any $ on pokemon go. Updated. I still stand on not spending money on this company. Even when I purchase remote raid passes through coins i've accumulated through gyms, The pokemon flee back to back to back. This company knows how to scam you out of your money one way or another. I can see why ppl spoof and try to trick the system now. 😑

It's a very awesome game, I play it just about every day (either in the evening or night). Except for only one problem, the battery on my phone was 85% before playing for ~10-15 minutes. Then, after those 10-15 minutes, I went to check & it was at 27%... (Not sure, though, but it could've been from the location service) The battery drainage problem needs help fixing ASAP. Otherwise, you guys nailed everything else on the game. Thanks a bunch.

Played the game since 2016, still play it especially during Summers. I have recently had a problem with the weekly challenge in the social section though. I tried joining a group, and even had a friend invite me to one, but it doesn't seem to want to pair me into a group to complete the challenge. Already deleted and downloaded the game again, cleared cache, etc. Not really an option to address it in the "help" tab of the game so thought I'd write a review for possible help.

An AR action game. A good way to get exercise and enjoy doing it. You can battle with friends from all over. The game definitely has a hard time running consistently. There are lots of really cool aspects to this game. If you are in a big city this game is for you. If you live in the country, it's hard to get gifts ect. Overall there are glitches, most have quick fixes.

I stopped playing for the winter and all the game does is crash now. It crashes when I bring my buddy out. It crashes when I try to take a snapshot of that buddy. It crashes while trying to catch something. It lags all of the time. I've updated and tried many different parks and then I came here to read reviews and see that I'm not the only one who can't seem to go 10 minutes without the game crashing.

Excellent game, wish it had a pedometer widget or at least the pedometer worked better, according to pokemon go I've walked 1.7k since yesterday, but according to my pedometer I've walked 3k just today. update: they made it better. it now tracks my steps (it has for some time) and I'll open my app to a pleasant surprise of all the walking I've done during the day without noticing. 10 years later and I'm still playing with friends.

Amazing game that allows for an immersive experience. As a day 1 player, I can say that this game improves over time. It helps motivate me and my peers to get out and socialize, even meeting with large groups in our community and having a fun time. It's even playable without spending any money, though it takes more effort. Definitely worth it, though.

Has been a motivator in going for walks. Edit: I had to dock stars after playing it longer. While I still use it as a fun diversion while walking, the limitations on the inventories for Pokemon, items, & postcards are frustrating. Coupled with your ability to earn the cash shop currency being capped at 50/day, it takes far too long to fix. Long distance friends have to buy special raid passes for $ in order to battle together, & you can only have 3 at most. Too many microtransactions/pay-to-win.

Review update lots of Pokemon but they continue to be the same ones they need to be more of a variety to be able to continue to catch different ones and do the tasks. it would be nice to be able to actually catch a zapdos or Articuno or Moltres when they appear instead of getting one try and then they always bounce. how am I ever going to get one of you guys won't let me at least get a few chances to catch it.

I love this app so much, but it has problems. Not a lot but they exist. You can definitely play this game freely without paying but if you want everything you need to pay. The battle league is horrible and I'm one of the few who said it's fine. I like it, but it needs some work. If you like walking and need something to do while doing it pokemon go is perfect

Day 1 player here telling anyone who wants to play Battle League to forget it. That's strictly for a PC player. it's that busted. they want your time and money but won't fix the game. what's that about? no more money from me from here on out. they should be paying ME to play at this rate. it was fun but the party's over. Too greedy, too many cheaters, no fun anymore.

The game itself is good, have been a player since the first month it launched. But as years went by, they added pay-for-event tix and paid extras - ridiculous and greedy. Accessing the android app used to be fine until recent update(s); now I'm constantly toggling back and forth between wifi (full bars) and 5G data to try to continue game play or to log back on because it freezes so much, causing bottom screen buttons/icons to disappear and have to back out of app itself. Niantic, fix this bug!

Its fun forsure. Pokémon is just money hungry though and so many things were added, yet it makes it useless to be a solo player which I am because of where I live. If your out in the middle of nowhere there should be chances for you to play without money being the only one. While we're at it and off topic; their low printing rates, scalpers because of it and the incredibly low hit rates are ridiculous. They know they have a "loyal" fan base but it ruined them in a way. Hello MTG! 😀

The game is a shell of its former self. Buggy beyond belief, constant soft-bans for just catching Pokémon or driving through town, paywalled content and p2w mechanics, updates that make the game visually unappealing, and more. I've been playing since 2016 and the game was in a genuinely better, more interesting, and fun state around 2016-2018. Now? Can't even recommend it even if you're just looking to dump Pokémon into Pokémon Home.

The battles become so irritating. You are about to win and then it completely freezes on you, and there's no way to report it for y'all to look deeper into the problem. It was just froze so long that our battle timed out. That's bs. Even if it's a cheat or whatever, there should be a way to report it for y'all who watch over the app can look into the problem. This happens way too often for there not to be a way for y'all to get reports on who to look into.

Was heated last time because I would throw a ball at low combat power pokémon with a green outline and it would still break out instantly. Game is actually fun and you kind of have to be on it a lot to be good. Only issue I have is that sometimes when I'm on the road or the sidewalk it will just have a lag spike and then I have to restart the game. Very fun game though. I recommend if you like to go outside, have a lot of spare time, or want to play a game with family.

Game is fun with a variety of activities and rotation of themed items. I can afford the occasional premium purchase as I don't play this day in and day out so I don't need many premium items. Since the updates in April 2026 though, the Quest listing, Event-themed and Monthly quests tab keeps blinking in and out when I try to scroll down the quest actions or even the list of prizes. This turns the game into a nightmare for strobe-sensitive players, so now I am playing even less often.

I played Pokemon Go when it first released and had a lot of fun with it. I stopped playing for a few years and decided a few days ago to try again. After 2 days of playing, my account got flagged for breaking rules which I haven't, tried getting support to no avail, it was a week so I decided ok I would wait and play again. That was 3 days ago, I opened the app today and got a second strike and can't even open it. Got flagged when not even playing. Support is useless, don't waste time on this.

LOVE IT. I love how they add new features and different ways to make the game better, but sometimes when I walk the game lags and says I'm across the city until it finds where I'm actually at. Sometimes if It's there long enough it's good with new pokemon and gyms or sometimes it just freezes there trying to find your real location.

Started playing the game when it came out. However, this game used to be fun. BUT, by adding TOO MUCH to the game (dynamax, max, gigantimax, etc), it has become too confusing and hard to keep up with. The original "gym format" shouldn't have been changed. If you don't have a pokemon powerful enough to take or defend a gym......find one you can. OR make gyms based on levels or strength of pokemon (tiers). Also, 4 star pokemon and shinies rates should increase after a set level (50+).

Used to be more fun. Since the Scopely takeover, it's becoming more and more of a pay-to-play game. There's constant events where they want you to buy a pass to get the good stuff. Honestly, having events that start right after the previous one ends is becoming exhausting. Then, they keep adding more resources you end up having to pay for if you want to do more than one or two battles during a weekend event. It's too much and I'm done buying anything on this app. So I won't be able to play much

Edit: Recently there's been way too many pop-ups. Overall, the game is pretty fun and addicting. The servers are now much more stable than they were when the game first released, which actually makes it playable for more than a few minutes. Still, though, the game has a lot of issues that Niantic needs to address and straighten out. This includes the 3-step bug and balancing out some of the game mechanics (such as gym battles).

Overall I really enjoy the game. It is a good way to learn more about pokemon and how to fight with them as well. While I do really enjoy the game, there are a few reasons why I gave it 4 stars. Due to word limit, it will have to be brief. - Randomly freezes as you catch pokemon - some raid pokemon are insanely hard to catch and seems like they want you to buy passes to catch them. - Storage space is easy to fill. To get more (choosing to buy) the amount you get is so small.

This game seems to have lost its way. All the added features since its inception seem to overload phones. I have a phone with a battery that will last all day, except for when I use this app. The network disconnects a lot. Frequently, my password isn't recognized, and that ends play for the day. I notice the developers seem to ignore feedback. The heyday may have passed us by.

Okay, I'll give pokemon go 3 stars. I remember playing the game way back when it came out and it was fun as it still is now. But now these days, there are all kinds of login issues. the graphics suck and the sound quality is horrible. when are they going to make an update that actually makes the game better and moves pokemon go to the next stage. its been almost 10 years since the game came out and almost nothing has really changed.

I have played since day one, and will likely keep the game on my phone for the rest of it's days. There has always been the expected growing pains for an app and definitely more than a few infernal bellsprouts who just won't stay in the ****** ball, but what a world they've put together for everyone here. I get postcards from places I'll never see, it's created conversation out of thin air, countless times, and its something our whole family spends time bonding over. 5 stars forever.

When I click on anything in the app the screen goes completely black. I have done a force stop and also uninstalled/reinstalled the app. I even went as far as to restart our router and my phone. There is a limited time on some of the monthly events (that I actually paid for) and I am unable to do anything in the game. I am really frustrated because other family members in the house are not having any issues and one of them has the same phone as me.

It's come a loooooong way since it's glitchy & limited 1st gen days, but there's still a lot more work to be done. PVP needs a balancing overhaul, prices have almost doubled on everything, and it seems like the pokemon have become harder to catch. Part of me only continues to play because of all the time & money I've dumped into this game over the years, but at least it's an extra way for me and my girlfriend to bond. That, and it DOES still encourage outdoor exercise, despite how greedy it is.

The latest updates are so incredibly frustrating that I'm considering uninstalling. They introduced a "Reward Road" to give player items when you make certain purchases, but the Niantic website no longer has the page to redeem rewards and you can't do it in-app. I transferred Volcanion to Home and now I permanently can't complete research tasks. Oh, and on top of that, the AI support chat does not work at all! There's no way to report the issues with the AI.

The best this game has ever been. Generous update last year created so much extra space in all inventories for FREE. I highly recommend it! That being said I have to nick one star as there are some goofy glitches here and there. On occasion it loads halfway and just...stops loading? Occasional visual glitches on gyms. Sometimes game bugs when doing raids. In my case a relaunch fixes any of these things, but this is still annoying regardless.

Loving the game besides the problem after defeating gyms. When you win, the loading screen afterwards is way too long and other people take the gym from you, even when it says it doesn't happen. I've lost multiple gyms because of this and didn't have the power to defeat it all over again. If you get out of the loading screen quicker, same thing happens. Very disappointing, please change it.

Basically a money scam now. Bugs with screen freezes, catch failures, glitches uploading, glitches downloading, and the update designed to "prevent cheating" just causes further errors. Not spending anymore money on this game, and it's basically Pay-to-Play now, so not really playing anymore.

Played on & off again since release in 2016. Game use to be amazing, everyone you saw played the game, it was fun to play for all ages. I got back on after quite a few months, maybe a year & there were significant changes that just seemed to change the aspect of the game🫤 You would think after nearly a decade of playing, you'd be close to catching them all but they keep creating new Pokémon that didn't even exist in the mainline. As i get older, this just isn't for me anymore. It has been fun

Now the recent update/upgrade is so good that you have to click on a gift multiple times before it will let you open it. guess it wants to make sure you want your friends gift? the new layout also is sus and was not broken so they decided it needed to be fixed for their own amusement. add the lag, glitching and inability to smoothly transition from WiFi to cell data, this is the game for you! Don't do anything you want to keep going from WiFi to cell data. it will crash just about every tim.

I have been playing this game since it originally launched and I really enjoy some of the changes that have been made over the years. One biggest complaint now is that the play with your pokemon feature has always been difficult to work with, and that's hasn't improved. It tells you to look for an open flat surface but then never gives me to foot steps to place a pokemon making leveling friendship and gathering gifts very difficult.

YIKES I played this game on release on my old phone, OnePlus 3. It heated up and drained the battery like crazy 8 years later I play it on my new phone, OnePlus 9. It heats up and drains the battery like crazy Sometimes the prompt buttons become unresponsive, it doesn't see the GPS, and continues having persistent issues I would imagine a game continuously developed for 8 years would address. Especially on the optimization side, since I don't even use the AR functionality

Update: My pokemon eventually returned from the gym after a couple of weeks however I did see in one of the gyms 2 pokemons that stayed there for over 95 days, this is unacceptable. Another thing is that on android phones you can't redeem codes in the app and have to go in a website unlike iPhone users who can redeem it in app in the poke store. This is a decent game however I'd like these problems to be evaluated. Please fix this Niantic.

The game is a lot of fun when the app works. It's pretty glitchy. I sometimes have to open and close it repeatedly to get it to load my location. The layout of the app needs attention. I can never find my rewards because they're scattered across four or five menus plus a couple of other places I wouldn't think to click. Having everything in one place would actually make sense.

This game has gone downhill hard. The best years are behind it, which sucks as this game was actually good. It started going downhill after the pandemic. The changes to the remote raid pass, the newer pay to win events, & of course the selling of the game to Scopely. All that among other things make this game no longer worth playing in 2025... which is extremely sad. I highly suggest all players save their Pokemon by transferring them to Pokemon Home then uninstall this game & never look back.

I love this game with a burning passion. My only issue with it really is when there's one pokemon in the middle of a couple others that you CANNOT check unless you capture the ones around it. There has to be some sort of fix for this. It's not a major problem just annoying when you want to see the pokemon and have to go through catching the others just to check it.

Just a bad game. Brings out the worst in people. Creators claim it supports community, but all it does is divide it. And like 8 out of 10 times you go to a gym it gives "gym under construction" error which has been going for months! They keep adding more to it but cannot even fix the most basic functions of the game, like throwing a pokeball...Just horribly managed and then they lie and capitalize on errors they create. Could be such a great game but it's not. Too bad.

This current version removes the navigation bar whole sale, this means I cannot use the home button or swap apps, or even use the back button on certain screens. Please consider instead an option to choose between. Doing so without asking trainers feels like a bad move in my opinion. The flee button is on the upper left hand corner which is far more inconvenient for catching in a full-screen mode.

I really enjoy Pokemon Go and have been playing since the release in 2016. Its a good excuse to get out and spend some time outside to "touch grass". However, the Android app has significantly more issues than the iOS app does. I have to sign out and back in on average about 4 times per week and deal with freezes daily. This would be a 5 star review if the app was more flushed out, but given the issues I have seemingly just playing the game I can't give more than 3.

Been playing for years. Got a new phone, worked for a week, and now will never come up again. I click on the play option it loads then gets to the screen where I press on or to where announcements are, and then it shuts down again. If they fix it, I'll change it.

Certain features like routes are still INCREDIBLY buggy even after a long time. Which wouldn't be a problem is evolutions weren't locked behind it. I can not recommend this app at this stage because it doesn't feel like the devs adds even trying to fix the issue. And THAT is why I have it such a low score.
super raids are terrible. that said, at least they seemed to comp a reasonable amount of mega energy.

Editing this to a one-star for one simple reason: They bricked the game on 32 bit android, and not everyone has the cash for a new phone with a better OS. Probably done with this franchise for good, and Skylanders was a better game series as a kid anyway.

Absolutely disappointing during raids. Did 2 legendary raids with remote passes this morning after winning, I did not get a catch encounter. Followed their steps and submitted a ticket for assistance, but they replied and said I had the encounter or was reimbursed. Neither of those had happened as my journal showed no encounter, and I had to go buy more remote passes. There's no other way to get assistance apart from bots. This app glitches a lot, and this isn't the first time this has happened.

I enjoy the game, however when you took Giovanni out of the balloons, I don't get a chance to find him, so I can never finish those quests. It is quite frustrating when you don't have the time or ability to search for hours trying to find a pokestop where it might be him. I have also seen a lot of other complaints about how it is really broken and he isn't showing up at all. Hopefully you fix that soon.

im putting 2 stars because its extremely annoying once you get to a certain point in the game they make you follow routes. not everyone can do that. youre taking away half of the game creating challenges like ya. sure good idea.... but now I have 4 of my challenges being routes that I cant proceed on. at least allow them to be deleted and create a new challenge

this game used to be fun. however, it evolved to be another massive and sad dystopian cashgrab. they introduce A LOT of unnecessary mechanics/features, most of it for the sake of artificial rarity, and almost every one of those, no matter how tiny, is time-locked and money-locked. I don't mind spending money for a game, it makes me happy, and it supports the game's development. but this game's just unreasonably and immorally expensive. Good luck catching up unless you spend thousands of dollars.

Recently there is this problem where some wins in the battle place aren't even registered. The rewards you get for winning x battles out of 5, even that is not given, which it should be, rightfully. Also, sometimes I teleport back and forth repeatedly to a place I've visited, but hours ago, and back to my original place. Also, sometimes even when I have a good network, when I battle Team GO rocket members, the screen just goes black and all 3 of my selected good pokemon have fainted.

Game killed off by latest update. absolutely horrendous. It goes slow and glitches when trying to catch. Throw the ball and it goes about 1cm however when you catch after winning a raid(white balls) or Dynamax raid, it's totally fine. Gone through about 150 balls to catch about 5 Pokemon. It's now an unplayable. Great shame as it was great for years and now they've gone and destroyed it. Takes up tonnes of memory to so will have to sadly be deleted. Such a shame.

Redownloaded after not playing for a few months. App crashed twice. Turned off all notifications and still received several notifications. Discovered starly, one of the most common wild encounters, is the community day pokemon? Deleted the app again. (2026) Impressive how many game breaking glitches there still are. Regularly crashes, icons won't load, freezing, stuttering.

While this used to be my favourite game, it has become quite large and usually takes 2 minutes to load and the performance when catching pokemon and walking around is quite low. I've never had this game run smoothly except when I first installed it for a week or two. The game play itself is very fun though, and I think the challenges add a neat 100% aspect to the game!

Its a fun game which encourages going outside and physical exercise, however the game starts at a pretty slow pace in the beginning with limited tasks and not so powerful pokemon. It can also get very grindy. Plus in the middle of pokemon encounters the game can randomly glitch but not so often anymore. Otherwise it's a great game for low low price of free and a great and motivating way to catch pokemon and go outside, you need mobile data though. (if you have a phone it's fine)

Amazing experience! Feels like the Pokemon games, has a LOT of Pokemon and encourages everyone to get up and walk. There are literally NO ads at all and it's really easy to play. It drains a little bit too much battery from my phone but that's really just 🆗 judging the entertainment it gives me. Overall this app is very awesome and if ur planning to get it I'd tell you to go ahead.

The game has definitely become pay-to-advance. Now get the message in-game when on top of a Poke-stop that I am "out of range" when I am right next to it. The cons are starting to outweigh the pros. During battles, it's daft how many taps on the screen it takes for the charged attack to actually work, same with the Rocket Grunt/Leader battles. Just goes to show that Niantic is only bothered about one thing and it's not the fans.... it's the money.

Love it! This game is so cool and the Pokémon are so cute! This game also brings me motivation to work out! But, one feature that I HATE. I was just checking out the game and I saw that one route had my favorite Pokémon, Litten. So I had to walk about 3 kilometres and when I tried to catch it it fled away. Please, Pokémon team, remove Pokémon fleeing cause it's so frustrating and disappointing.

Lets break this down; in its latest set of latches, they shadow nerfed a good bit of the players abilities to catch pokemon. Pairing this with inconsistent throws, despite the pokemon, random disconnects during rare captures or harder raids. Not to mention how pay hungry they are getting for you to make progress, nerfing the catch rate like we would not notice, or making a creatures run chance increase with the rarer items being used. The state of this game, don't pay for a thing.

Honestly one of my top 5 mobile games. To anyone that loves Pokémon this is the game for you. You get to actively catch Pokémon while moving in real time, and this game can get your steps In really easy if you like that. With ther always fresh raids and challenges there's always something to do. In all this is a game i always seem to come crawling back to, and it keeps you active. 💯

Do not recommend and absolutely do not download this app, it's a scam for the most part. The company will pay lock any little thing and pretty much force you to pay for regular things that normally have been included, this company is greedy and will not help with actual glitches or issues in the game. Making the most random UN-needed changes and completely ignoring glitches/issues that have been in game for years. DO NOT DOWNLOAD!!!!

The game is really good, and I like how it is based on real world! Still, it's a great game, fun to play. As well as the network issues and battery consumption, I think one of the improvements it needs is to spawn more Pokemon in rural areas instead of cities, because in the Pokemon universe the creatures are always found outside of towns.

The constant updates are very inconvenient and seem a bit unnecessary. I don't know about anyone else, but since this game takes up quite a lot of space, updating it is a huge hassle that usually prevents me from playing the game for a while, since I have to delete other apps in order to make room for the update. I would prefer larger updates that happen occasionally, rather than one every week.

Amazing concept, learning new places and monuments I've never noticed before! Pokemon are also mainly in the city, which isn't very logic. No point in traveling around, just head to a big city. Update: Few years later, game sadly still a disappointment..clogs up a ton of space too. Took them years to implement the things they promised from the starting trailer and it's still not the game that was promised.

Super sad the crown tundra pants were removed. When I tried to change my outfit the game glitched out my avatar, turing it into the default male character. When I changed everything back I looked for the pants and they were gone. The were the only bottoms I actually liked, so I am very disappointed that that are missing. I also wish there was an option to change the colour of the masks. Overall fun game.

I really love this app, it's very well developed, the animations are beautiful and the graphics are perfect, just one issue though; whenever I try to catch a pokemon, it always said "Camera orientation not found" or something along those lines and I really want to capture them in real life, not just in game. I was wondering if there is a way to fix this?

Great game overall. A couple issues: -When battling a gym, I'll spend time and resources lowering the Pokemon's CP. When the CP is low enough (the last battle before it allows you to add your own Pokemon to the gym), other players will steal the last battle and it appears like they defeated the gym when they only came at the last second. I first started playing this game when it first came out, then went on a long hiatus. Would love to see the next improvements.

So basically I'm a returning player and I have been facing problems with the location thing ... No matter how many times I go to take a walk or drive , but it always shows no distance covered what so ever !!! The need you guys to fix this issue coz I am not getting any things even from taking baby steps in the game its almost frustrating ! Best Regards,

I've been playing this game for a while and enjoying it, despite it being exceptionally buggy. Frequently, I would just be logged out and I'd have to jump through a bunch of hoops (such as deleting cache) in order to log back in. Whenever it needed an update I would actually need to delete and reinstall it. On its most recent update I can't even reinstall it. This is preposterously broken.

This app is amazing on so many levels. There are a few minor problems about it though. Battling someone can sometimes cause the game to glitch and getting me to lose. And also sometimes when you click on the pokemon the game glitches and says. Error pokemon not found. I am not using any short tricks to catch pokemon. And lastly I think they should do max coins of 75 in stead of 50. But apart from that. This is an amazing app and the events make it even more and more interesting.

I've been having major problems loading the game since last week. I've been informed I'm not the only person having issues & that there is a 'small sub-set' of trainers having the same issue. Whilst Niantic have been keeping me updated with their efforts to resolve the issue I'm still unable to log into my account. I hope they sort it soon. I'm at level 39 (almost 40) & I don't want to have to try & start again from scratch & have wasted a lot of time, money & energy in the process.

11 satellites and (sometimes) they still cant find me. So 4 stars. The game is addictive, very "I want more!" So be prepared to walk to find or meet your goals. OH! just for the record, the app cant tell the difference between walking and running. when I go running, it thinks Im in a car and doesnt log the miles Ive ran!!!! Not good. Also! when you actually are in the passenger side of a car and are passing a stop, be prepared for the pokestop not to recognise you! ARGH!

It's been unstable and none of the updates have done anything to improve that, but I stuck with it and spent a lot of time and a fair amount of money - then we get to the anniversary event and supposed to be lots of bonuses but my account just stops working - not banned (I'm a stickler for the rules and no ban email) - just won't log in, tried multiple devices. So I'm missing out on all the anniversary bonuses, and I can get NO response from support, absolutely zero.

3 years ago, during the pandemic, niantic made great changes to the game to make it more accessible. Since then, rhey have gone out their way to erode it all, whilst telling everyone "it's for the good of the game". This game is being ruined by niantic. Its a company that refuses to listen to its player base and instead would rather make people play a certain way so they can sell the location data (not individual, but age groups and gatherings)

The game got old quickly. Niantic is too concerned about spoofing and not concerned enough about the content of the game. Provide an in game controller that allows people to wander in a limited radius around their location say 300 meters. This allows for people to be able to play at home or from a safe spot but also allows for them to have get out and go somewhere if they want to change things up.

The game has a solid foundation, catching Pokémon and battling with them is fun. But there are enormous problems with the developers, they seem to care more about how much location data they can extract from you. Their recent changes to prices of items and the frequency of their use is massively anti-consumer and shows the trajectory this game has been on since the pandemic. The game is currently 2 star worthy but I think it may be 1 star soon enough.

Came back on 26/2/19 (Last played early 2018) There's a lot more features that seem to be quite good. Battling so far seems to be both based on your Pokemon's CP and your skill. Their elements do play a part as well. Being up to Generation 4 now is also a win. Now, the reason I've given it a 3/5 (Was 2/5). While there has been an increase in Pokemon spawn rate, I still have to go over 2km to get any form of Pokemon, or stops, or gyms. I unfortunately can't drive for medical reasons.

Recent update is not tracking step outside of app, even though this is meant to be turned on!!! Great game, it's helped me get out more. But it needs more features, like being able to see where clusters of pokestops are, more instructions of how to battle, even being able to heal your pokemon if you put them in a chamber and have to walk 10k like with the eggs. And footprints need to return.

One of my favourite games, even all these years after it came out. Harder to free-play these days. Some small changes I would like to see - pre-populated the pokemon's stats, eg under their name or as a visual bar - remote raid passes more easily attainable again - order of postcards in the book by location/distance from me, so I can see duplicates - order of stickers by 'Most Recent'(ly acquired) and 'Number of Copies', when I'm selecting them for a postcard

I just tried playing for one of the first times since last summer and decided to buy a lucky egg and an incense. They've both been on for ten minutes, but my game apparently can't reach my GPS. So I just wasted real money on the frustration of not being able to play the game. So, I just keep open and closing the app and watching the time for my items drop more and more. Quite unimpressed. Just wanted to get back into the game.  And now they are both finished, and I didn't get to use them whatsoever. Except for one rattata... A RATTATA, come on.

Why is it more expensive to purchase larger bundles of coins for less coins? For example, for $0.99 you get 100 coins, but for $13.99 you get only 1200 coins. Usually when you spend more money, you get a better deal! 🤔 Also, it's almost impossible to complete quests (like Meltan) now because you have moved onto new tasks and no longer release the Pokemon needed to complete the quest. For example, we can no longer hatch a Ditto or Areodactyl, so we are just stuck on our current tasks.

In my opinion, this game is an interesting one. I like the idea of walking around to catch pokemon. However, I must say some of the requirements are too high as I play. The reason is - in my place a very few people plays it, as it is very small village. It takes eternity to level up for me, as in my place there are not many Pokémon. The style and non-AR version of the game is perfect for older devices, too! Except for high requirements, I like the gave very much.

The game has got a lot better then when it was first released, but seems to be a lot more bug's and sometimes lag. I personally don't like the pay model but that's business, I know it will never change. I have been playing five years now and I still get a lot of fun out of shiny hunting, an as I work the community days are great for that. So hopefully they will continue to improve the game, an maybe boost the shiny rate for me lol.

Used to absolutely love this game, then after over a year of playing I was unable to load my info unless I was on wifi - and it's a game you play using data - but the game started crashing every 5 minutes as well as camera access being turned off but instead of the steady landscape you instead get a white and hard to balance background. It's difficult to complete the pokedex and some of the missions (which are unskippable) require you to go pokemon hunting with friends - and no one plays on this app anymore because of how buggy and generally bad it is. Honestly, if I could sort the data issue, I would probably still play it. But because there seemingly is no fix for this, I can essentially no longer play.

I've been playing since day 1. Actually, I've been playing even before it was available in my country. Was able to get a pretty complete living dex, including regional forms, costumes, etc. It's been a handful of awesome years playing this game and I was able to meet many people and communities probably wouldn't outside of the game. Unfortunately, these last months have been awful and Niantic's decisions completely ruined the game and I'm uninstalling the game for good. Unreal management.

Niantic(devs) seems to be highly paid gaming experience oriented company as of now. They refuse to hear the players' opinions, so don't come expecting the game to be considerate for the players. Increasing the interaction distance in the game is just one example of many. The earning of pokecoins (in-game currency) was also reduced & limited down to 50 per day to 'encourage' the players to spend money. It's NOT Free-To-Play game with in app purchases, rather the other way round.

Great casual game - competition is a focus, but you can avoid it and choose to not PvP. However, since day one, it's been targeted towards flagship model phones, and people who use mid to low-rage phones are generally unable to enjoy the game because it uses too much resources. Every asset is almost PS3 levels of detail by polycount alone, for Pete's sake! There is not even an option to downsize the resolution of the game - an option responsible yet smaller devs do for this game engine (Unity).

Overall... it wasn't too bad. The prices are quite reasonable, the cheapest coin pack is actually affordable, but the 550 coin pack is somehow more expensive that buying 5 100 coin pack, weirdly enough. The mission rewards weren't half bad, but somehow the mission progress was slower than my game progress. Also, I don't like that more than half the landmark aren't updated to the recent condition, and while grinding isn't easy in normal games, this one is much2 harder in real time.

This game has so much potential, yet the developers took this precious diamond of an idea and basically just make us use it as a paper weight. 2 years into development and it's the same throw & tap, just getting more and more rare shinys you'll never find and stupid unbalanced events that are either too good to miss out or too boring to even go out. It just sucks that the battle part of the game lacks almost everything that was cool about Pokemon. At least you get the chance to socialize with some awesome people, go outside and get some fresh air and exercise, thanks for that.

I think this game has a lot of potential. I'd like to see it become awesome. Update: Played this for several years, spent a lot of cash on it. Not worth it. They just add more pokemon for you to collect which dilutes the spawns for all of them, making it harder to catch the ones you want. Now events are locked behind paywalls. Tried so many times to get enough people for 5 star raids, next to impossible. So many things wrong with this game, frustrated, leaving

The game is enjoyable, BUT hell you do waste a lot of time with minding numbing tasks. For example, you can do 100 trades a day, but each one has to be done separately, you cannot multiple select like you can with emails in your Inbox or photos in your Gallery, who has all that time to waste if you have a bunch of pokemon to trade with a friend, when you want to be catching more! And to take a simple photo of a pokemon involves 6 clicks! If this was a business app it would fail on productivity!

This was a fun, casual game where players could choose to battle at gyms or just collect pokemanz, share pictures and get out, walking to hunt them. But, if you don't have unlimited data, it's difficult to catch pokemanz outside or go to pokespots. The game uses a lot of data and drains my battery very quickly. Still, the game has improved a great deal.

Your app could list the installed software you believe violates the terms of service. The "Your device is not compatible" message is a passive-aggressive method. My device is not rooted though I eventually figured out I had a copy of SuperSU installed. Just tell us what needs to be removed? Be upfront about it. Giving you 1 star for hours wasted troubleshooting. Please add an extra error message or an incompatible app list on your support site!! Would be a 4 star game otherwise.

I installed the game again after 2 years without playing. I stopped playing because of the Raid system where I would never be able to find players in my city to play the raids with and the difficulty to get gold to actually move forward. If this is still an issue, I'm glad to find a league system, the team Rocket and other new good things. This is actually starting to look like a real life Pokémon adventure. Some day I'll get my Feraligatr 🤤

This version does not work on my phone, keeps telling me it's not 
compatible! It was fine less than a month ago, this bug needs to be fixed. 
It's driving me crazy and has been getting worse daily, can't trust it to 
stay on long enough to catch a Pokemon let alone go between apps. Today it 
has stopped more times than I can count, and that's just from the times it 
managed to open. Opening alone sometimes take about 5 to 10 attempts!

Lots of glitches unfortunately. When I catch something it will freeze, a white line at the bottom of the app about a half inch covering almost all of the bottom icons. When I'm a passenger in a car, even if we are going like 10km, often the pokestop will spin but tells me to try again. All extremely annoying. Everything else is fun, besides the glitches.

This game had potential right out of the door but countless mismanagement and testing made much needed updates very slow. Now, in 2021, we're starting to fall victim to the same events with some minor tweeks as they hope for more to buy into the game. However, the same underlying issues make the game feel dated, clunky, and a sad excuse for the amount of money and time that went into its life. I through with nothing exciting happening. Goodbye UN-synced, horrible UI sounds. I'm leaving.

Great until there is a glitch. Have tried emailing support twice only to get an automated email saying I have to report the bug in app.... problem is I can not get the app to open. Went to my local Pokémon go Facebook page to see if anyone else is having the issue or has had and what they did. Tried it and still will not let me open the game.... I would hate to lose my progress or worse not be able to play anymore. Not sure what else to do if I can't email support and can't report bugs in app.

DO NOT PLAY. Hypocritical game that only allows "one account per player" but allows multiple sign-ins per device. Only has one way to get free coins, but does not limit each account's time in the gym to 8 hrs 20 mins daily (to get the coins) and allows bullies to take over as many gyms as they want to without consideration for other players. The company will continue getting away with it because players generally don't stand up for one another.

great game. Aside from breeding, it reflects most of pokemon gameplay in a more interactive manner. But the game is riddled with bugs. I noticed a premium pass disappeared from my inventory even though i hadn't done raids... And i'm pretty sure that despite being a lvl up reward, that it didn't have an expiration date. In the gyms when you click on the spin the game sometimes brings you through a bugged animation to an unusable screen. Just to name a few because i reached the character limit

just horrible. the last few months I've struggled to load in at all. there was a brief couple week period it seemed to be resolved, but now it's worse than ever. today for example, tried to load in for 30 minutes!!!!!! and you can't leave the loading screen lol. sometimes it would throw an error, sometimes it would just give me the silent treatment. it would give me juust enough hope by loading till halfway, every goddamn time. I'm so done with this

So far so good but getting too complicated now. Although, the Raid Boss and the legendary Pokemon makes the game more exciting. However, they are getting too complicated along with time. I like the simpler earlier version in which you can do solo with boss or needed a fewer people to raid the 5-star boss. Or you can collect things randomly from wherever you go. Now, it is more of everything, puzzle, accumulate skills, collect items, making quests. Popularity of the game will plunge down.

Decided to return to Pokemon Go after not playing it for a year. From the get go, I wasn't able to login due to the app apparently needing to be updated, and it booting me to the Google Play store. The only issue being, I installed the latest version of the app from the store in the first place... Cue a cycle of frustration as I attempted to keep logging in and the game booting me out. Story your game up, niantic!!

The lag during battles is beyond frustrating. Frequently, the charged attack buttons don't show up when you change Pokémon until your opponent has already hit theirs. Battles also will just freeze, and the only way to do anything is to quit the battle. It's incredibly frustrating, especially with the battle limit. I've experienced this on various different wifi connections and on phone data. Sometimes, when you change your battle party, it will put your previous battle party in the battle

Amazing game! This app has come so far since it started. There are events, raid bosses, spotlights for pokemon and much more! My only issue with this game is that sometimes it will say, "You're going too fast", like it does when you're a passenger in a vehicle playing when I'm walking around lol. And it glitches during Raid Boss catching once in a while, which is frustrating. No game crashes. They've done great work to adjust the game to COVID-19 safety! All in all, a fantastic game to play!

This game is designed to waste away your time. You try to catch something valuable, you have to get through annoyingly long ball wiggle animations, pokémon breaks free despite ultraball/spinning/great throw, and after 4th try, runs away. Then all the pop-up menus, checking IVs, hidden level, feeding companion could be 10 times faster, so I can't use it while being out in the city.

Really good game, but I can't do much where I am due to the lack of other players in this area, making it virtually impossible so continue, not only this but raising the prices of everything in the item shop is just ridiculous, the remote raid passes in particular, I feel 150 or 120 would be better than 195. However, when you have other players, it is very fun. One thing though, is it crashes way too much

Honest Review of Pokémon Go: Brilliant time waster when outside. Uses quite a bit of battery, even with "battery saving" mode. Way too many micro transactions. If you're disabled, in quarantine or simply unable to go outside, you can't do much but catch the same small amount of Pokémon that spawn near your house. There should be some sort of control from within your home. Servers are terrible. Lag and the very common "unable to authenticate" error requires you to reinstall the game every time.

The quality of a lot of things have gone down over the years especially a really annoying glitch during PvP where trainers can make use of three shields rather than the standard two. When submitted a report they blame it on 'latency issues' but this issue has been going on for more than two years with no resolution which is frustrating as a player. The things in the store have become more expensive as well and the free daily gift box always gives the same items.

I, like many others, am very disappointed in the recent changes in the game. Those complaints have already been enumerated by many others. It seems, though, that the game is now very difficult to load and freezes in the middle of play, battling, or doing a raid (when raiding is actually possible). Too bad cuz I was really enjoying the game.

Its a great game. but i would like an addition to the game where we can actually see other players on our screen as well. that way we can add friends easily or even battle them easily. scanning the qr code is good and all but its wierd to search for more friends by checking their screen to see if they are playing the game or not ( this app isnt as popular in my country ).

I usually never write reviews, but I am writing this, hoping things can change. After two weeks of playing Pokémon GO for the first time in years, it is really hard for new players to start in the game if they are not spending huge amounts of time and money. For those two weeks, I have been struggling to always have any space left in my backpack or in my pokemon storage. As well as some of the research tasks are impossible without someone to play with (ex. the party one). Please fix the game...

I wish I could rate this lower than 1 Star with Niantic's recent decisions. Obviously the majority of the profit they make is off of selling the users location and data (which is the whole point of "Adventure Sync" and allowing the app to track your location); but, the amount that Niantic has gutted fun features and functions for the actual player base is mind-boggling. It shows that they don't care about the Pokémon franchise, the player base. They care about your location and data

Infuriating to use. I keep getting kicked out and automatically signed out because the game "can't connect to server", even when my phone has a strong internet connection. I'm forced to sign in again, but it can never authenticate my information. It never says I entered anything incorrectly, just that it can't authenticate. I'm forced to reset my password every time. Niantic, get yourself together.

I've played this game for years off and on. Each time it's been better than before, but for some reason as of the last few updates, the game has become unbearably laggy. It has reached a point where it is borderline unplayable. I have adjusted all the in game settings and my phone settings, but it's still extremely slow. I've burned so many pokeballs and resources just trying to throw them or attack, but because of the lag you completely miss, or your pokemon faints because it didn't register.

Original review: Let's face it, we've been waiting for this for our entire lives! Then the devs stopped the game from working. I got to level 19 in a week, and have been unable to get past 21 in the next fortnight. Thanks devs!!! Suburban gameplay is literally impossible Updated review (2018>: after a long hiatus, I'm back in and it's great fun. I still miss the original tracking system, and I still think suburban gameplay sucks (let alone rural), but having moved into a denser region, and with more than two pokestops nearby, it's actually playable again, and great fun

Having an absolutely awful experience. On top of the 10+ minute wait times, it white-screens whenever I go to catch a pokémon. I went to change my username (as I had an old account) and I had to reload 5+ times. The keyboard would not open as I went to change my username and when it did, it would close the keyboard after typing one letter. Not worth it on android - I've tried to download it on an alternate device so we'll see how that goes.

Ahead of the release of this game there were alot of different features that were promised to be delivered only a short amount of time (some months) after the release of the game. Features such as Trainer vs Trainer, Common Loot System for every Trainer no matter the Trainer's current cordinates, a gamestyle where you can team up and make friends with your Pokémon and a great story you can relate to. None of these things have come out yet, and that's why the game is loosing interest.

To be honest, I waited for three years after release and tested the app on four different devices before I could eventually play and it was definitely worth the wait 😁 really enjoying, I was just hoping maybe for an update where Pokemon that have enough candies to evolve are highlighted when you view all your Pokemon, it would make it so much easier than having to sit, sort and go through each and every one (btw, I have about 200 so far), please please consider it, I think it would help a ton.

It's an amazing game that encourage you to explore places you haven't thought of visiting and make new friends. But it's also about pure luck. You could be spending time, money, energy, & battery life grinding, battling and other stuff yet still left frustrated with the results. While other players just take less effort and get way better pokemons. That is so not fair!

I downloaded GO a while ago and I absolutely loved it. However, I reached a stage of the game where it was impossible for me to progress; I had no Poké Ball left in stock and due to living in a rural area, I could not access gyms and PokéStops, which are an important part of the game. It would be quite nice if more Poké Stop and Gyms could be created. Even then, I rate it five stars because it is a great game overall!

Poke Go's gameplay is shallow, but good enough to be worth playing socially. I wish raids weren't prohibitively hard for smaller groups of people, since a lot of Pokemon are locked behind them. Similarly there's little reason to catch the majority of Pokemon other than for the sake of collecting, as very few are useful in raids, and gym battles are easy enough not to worry. Even most legendaries aren't worth using unless you dump a load of rare candy into leveling them up to par with what you already have. My real issue comes from the bugginess of the game. I haven't been able to play consistently for the last six months without the game 'failing to log in', for days on end. I've found the only way to fix this near daily issue is to clear the cache, log out, and log back in, having to reset my settings each time. This is ridiculous, and makes it near impossible to have fun playing. Ruined the last few community days and wasted lucky eggs, until I just stopped trying to play.

The game is more fun now when they made more Pokémon spawn in suburban areas. The thing I don't like is the combat. Very tedious, boring and repetitive with just tapping and dodging. If they made it so that you could collect TMs and learn your Pokémon moves when reaching a certain CP, it'd make the game so much more worth to be fighting gyms as well as adding more stuff to collect and show off to your friends.

The game has a huge focus on micro transactions, the more you pay the better you play. As a result the game suffers unnecessarily from it. I don't mind paying for a game, but the current model is terrible. A subscription would be a much better payment model. The recent decision to revert some of the more than year long covid related changes in the name of profit at the cost of, not only enjoyment of the game, but also the safety of the game, has prompted me to make this 2 star review.

Good game if you're a pokemon fan, otherwise I'd be less confident recommending it. The game is somewhat past it's prime, both in terms of popularity (summer 2016) and ideal player experience (the company is actively rolling back improvements made during 2020 which aid rural and remote play because they can't sell as much data if you have to walk around less). It's still enjoyable if you did enjoy it in it's prime, but I don't know a lot of people who have stuck with it.

Horrible! This has happened so much that I decided to write this review. I always have an issue with the app hanging and freezing at the loading page. This has been like this at least 2 years now! And I've given up on this game. If Niantic wants people to give this a good rating, better get your issues together. Oh and it's super laggy too. I'm using OPPO F1s. There are only a few good days where they app runs really smooth. This is not worth my time anymore.

The concept is great, it was a massive hit and even gained news coverage. And yeah, going out to capture pokemon can actually be fun. But the problems? You can't fight with friends at your own leisure. You cant , say visit a friend's house and have just a short, friendly match. The only way you can fight are through gyms which is tedious. Plus you need data to play the game, if you don't have data then you can't progress whatsoever, which is off-putting for many, including me

I love this game, been playing since it came to the UK. However certain things are really starting to annoy me, for example, pokemon with incredibly low CP are somehow able to break out of ultra balls many times! Also, when battling, there should be an option to decline the mystery pokemon that you win. I've just used 60 pokeballs trying to catch one, all of my berries, multiple ultra balls and all of my great balls and STILL I haven't caught it! And I cant battle again till I've got it!

Edit 07/11/2018: the individual pokemon pages keeps crashing and there's no way to return to the pokemon bag view without exiting the game completely. Whilst it crashes, the favourite and appraise options, etc still work. __________ The app has come a long way. Game play is now a lot better and there are way more features. This game actually encourages me to go outside and go on walks. I do wish that more of the original 151 Pokemons will appear as these are the ones I'm familiar with from my childhood. Edit: after the recent update I have found that Pokemons break free a lot more frequently. For instance I might have had several good shots capturing the pokemon everytime but one has literally broken free more than 5 times. This is frustrating as it's too time consuming for one pokemon and depletes the pokeballs supply very quickly.

Enjoyable if you're out and about a lot. Game sometimes hangs when you click on a wild pokemon- requiring you to restart the game and lose the pokemon you were just trying to catch. The AR scan task is quite irritating, particularly if you don't have access to get exactly where the marker is. Even when you can- I've stood on an AR gym many times and it still tells me to get closer to scan it, though there was physically no way for me to get on top of it more than I already was.

I enjoy playing. I am disappointed that our pokemon cannot get better by fighting in the gyms, I want more varied options for my character, I want pokemon battles to look more like the game (or a strategy type game would be awesome) and my phone keeps freezing up while I walk or when I'm catching pokemon, requiring endless restarts. Hopefully, this new update will take care of some of those issues.

It's actually a good game, but there are some things that need to be fixed. If you attack a gym and clear two rounds alone, and in the last round, there is another player fighting with you from another team, then you may have to wait for them to place their Pokémon first, even though you started the gym fight first. It's quite frustrating because then you have to clear the gym again. And if you have no luck, other players come and place their Pokémon, so you have to battle more Pokémon.

I really love this game. But because I live in a town/not a city, there are so few gyms and pokestops in the area. Specifically where I live you cannot even see a gym on the screen, and there are 3 pokestops on the edges. I have to travel quite a few kilometers to find one. Been playing incredibly hard though and finally on level 35. But I'm growing tired of the limited experience from home since I can't do remote raids like other people can from their homes.

Game is good and so is the graphics. But the game keeps on freezing. I had to reinstall but it's the same issue. either scrolling through my inventory, pokemons or even doing raid battle and capturing, the game freezes for no reason. Cache is too many from this game i have to delete it everytime. Next time make the app 1gb plus so that all game resources are already in and no need to load. Please niantic read my review. I'm not the only one experiencing this problem.

I played this game from launch until about two years ago, when I took a hiatus from it. After redownloading the game, I am appalled and horrified by the changes forced on players by Niantic. Adventure sync on Android used to be integrated in a way where it would only gather info on how far you walked. Now it needs to read your location all the time. That's way too much info. Need I even mention the remote raid changes? Pure corporate greed and sad to see a game I enjoyed so much fall so far.

I rated it one star when it came out, it was buggy and the company refused to answer questions or give information and much of the information that had come out was wrong and they had over hyped the game in relation to what they put out. Now, like 2 years later or more, the game is much better. I don't know if the company has gotten better at customer service, but the game is fun and worth playing. The prices for buying things in game are insane, you should never buy anything, but only playing it free is fine and it encourages you to go out and walk!

Fun game that encourages me to go out and walk! There are a lot of folks talking about bugs here, but I haven't been having problems. My main gripe is spoofers ruining the fun for people who want to play the game as intended. Some moderation so far as this is concerned would be really great. I know spoofers converge online to cooperate. There has to be a way to crack down on that. It really does make it frustrating sometimes. I'll be playing for as long as it's available!

At this stage, the game has no storyline. Its only objective is to collect as many pokemon as possible. Controlling gyms offers the opportunity to collect a tiny number of in-game currency, but that's it. There's quite a few game features related to walking distance, but the game still can't track walked distance properly.

pokemon go is essentially unplayable now. all vehicle (high speed) play is entirely eliminated which is where the game was most playable originally. On top of that, ever since the beginning, the game was useless if you didn't live in a major city because you would never see any pokemon around where you lived. I'm not sure how the issues it originally had were never fixed but its actually gotten worse over time. This game needs a major overhaul and a re tooling if it's ever going to be any good.

It's fun, but the pricing is interesting. Most games on the market will give you discount when you buy in game currency which means the more you buy the cheaper it cost per unit. To pretend they care for your wallet. For example, if you pay $1 for 100 coins and for 1200 coins, instead of paying $12 usually you pay less let's say $11. But in Pokemon GO, you pay $1 for 100 coins, and for 1200 coins, you pay $15, which is more expensive. They don't even pretend! They want it bad!

The game is fun to play, when it works. Every time I've played this game it's bugged out in some way, whether it's the pokeball not shaking when trying to catch a pokemon, or when a pokemon escapes from the ball but it doesn't zoom back out for me try throwing another one, both meaning I have to restart the app. Then usually after that it says I'm unable to log in. And that farce continues for a good couple of hours sometimes until I can eventually log back in again. Basically, it needs a load of patches...

Game is awesome, it let's me live my childhood dream of finding Pokémon in "real life" and I thank you for that 👍. Everything is great except that there is one thing that is bugging me and that is that the roads do not show up on my map. The Pokémon, gyms, and Pokestops do but the roads in my area don't. So it basically looks like I'm playing in a big field of grass haha. Please fix, just a small issue but it's bugging me. Thanks!!! EDIT: Thanks for the fix, game and updates are awesome.

So much potential wasted. Niantic was responsible for the first thing humanity came to world peace, yet they failed. I've played the game since it's launch and even though it was always littered with bugs, but it was okay because it was fun. They managed to improve the game even more during the pandemic, making the game more accessible to the less able. After that it all went downhill. They slowly removed or limited every good new feature. Last straw was doubling the prices in the in game shop.

I played for a few days here (after 2 year hiatus) and I will be putting it down forever. The pay-to-win portion of this game is out of control. This game has diversified in so many things to keep things competitive and incentivise buying stuff in the shop to keep your edge. All we wanted was a real world pokemon where you walk, catch, train, & fight Pokemons. Shame on you Niantic.

It was enjoyable enough when I first started playing with my wife, but just like the pokemon company itself, the game has become stale, and I see very little interest in jumping back into it. The avatar changes were bad, but that's only one of many other problems with the game now. From the overpriced shop to the constant lag issues.

When I first started playing this game, I strove to collect all of the Pokemon. However, now that so many Pokemon are region-locked or otherwise gated -- mostly in limited-time egg events with incredibly low odds that Niantic refuses to disclose -- I've given up on ever completing that goal. Strange Eggs are an egregious new addition, requiring a disproportionate amount of work for a high chance of hatching literal garbage. Megas, similarly, require a great deal of time and effort to essentially rent a powerful Pokemon for a few hours. Events are too frequent, but normal spawns between events are horrible because almost all of the desirable Pokemon are unavailable in the wild. I'm giving the app two stars because I still find that attempting to get gold gyms gives me an incentive to walk more, but I do not care about anything else in the game. I dropped from frequently buying coins to completely free-to-play a year ago, and I can't see that changing.

I played this game for years now and im starting to enjoy it less ans less, simply because, with the recent update, Niantic are refusing to take into consideration players that either cant attend in person rais due to personal difficulties, or simply not having a large enough local community to deal with harder content, such as legendary and mega raids. However if this huge part of the game is to be overlooked, its still a pretty good game, but still, not as inclusive as it was and should be.

No help or tutorial at the start was dumb. And finding Pokémon takes forever, Thanks to the fact I don't live in a city. Great idea on straight up abandoning the countryside. Plus getting pokeballs is dumb, I get one or two from a stop. Should be given way more than that to be considered long term playable without paying which is clearly its main focus... I jump in and out but it's mostly just garbage and something to do for no real reason.

The game itself is great fun. Very well thought and gets more and more features. Regular events and a very nice community around it. The implementation on the other hand is poor at best. The game is full of bugs, kicking you out of raid battles for no good reason, errors out in the middle of anything. They obviously make a lot of money on the in-game purchases, I don't really get how they can low-ball their infrastructure.

October 2018 Edit: Pokemon Go has come a long way. Niantic seemed to wise up at some point and started actually talking to their customers. There has been a lot of good new content added to the game. There are still a few big issues with the game (battle system, gym system, performance, etc), but overall its pretty good right now. OLD EDIT: After seeing that concerns over the increased difficulty in catching Pokemon are being confirmed, yet still receiving zero communication from Niantic on anything at all, I have decided to drop my review down to 1 star. I cannot recommend anyone play this game, as it seems very clear that Niantic is only in it for the money and doesn't care about producing a product that is good for the player, only themselves. **Original review follows** This game could be an easy 5 star, but unfortunately due to unforeseen difficulties the developer is facing, and much more importantly the total lack of willingness on the part of the developer to communicate with their customers, this game is too much of a risk for me to feel good about encouraging people to play and spend money on this game. There are certainly some cool parts about this game, but without any reassurances on the part of the developer that they have heard the concerns of the players and are working to repair the problems currently in the game, I cannot in good conscience give this game a higer rating than 2 stars. Hopefully Niantic will realize that people are unhappy and correct their mistakes.

If you're playing this game ensure you have phone data to spare! Big data and battery hog. My only real complaint in regards to gameplay is the amount of time it takes to collect in-game currency. Of course the app needs to make money somehow, but only 50 coins can be gathered a day from gyms, making the process of collecting coins to expand the inventory (VERY necessary) quite tedious. Otherwise lots of fun, and a great motivator for getting some exercise in your day-to-day!

This is BS. I really want to like this game. I like Pokemon, the art style is appealing, there are some cool concepts in here plus lots of potential. But more than 2 years after release this is still a technical abomination. Poor performance on new phones, battery killer & constant freezes & errors: "Network Error", the infamous "Unknown Error" or, my favorite, lo and behold, "Error (0)"! Might as well tell me "F... YOU!" With all the $$$ they couldn't do a better job? REALLY? ERROR (0), I say!

Updated from my previous review (from 2016: 4 -> 3 stars). The gameplay has got more fun, and the previous issues are resolved. However the game is becoming more pay-to-play than it used to be. You now have to buy some special researches (not using the in game currency), and it is harder than ever to earn in game currency. It takes 3 days of acquiring the maximum daily coins in order to afford a single incubator, which is virtually impossible as it requires other people to beat your gyms daily.

Came back to the game after almost 6 years. Lots of new features. Game feels rewarding. Gym system is much better and you can easily get your 50 coins everyday. Only reason not 5* is that its pretty pay to win. I would give it 5 if you could get 150 coins a day. Would balance out the prices of things a bit and allow you to keep up with the people who spend a lot of money on the game.

Firstly, the game wanted to update while I was casually taking over a gym. It's the closest gym to my house. The game wouldn't let me play until I updated, which took about twenty minutes. From then on I can't even open the app, it just stays on the loading screen. I've tried uninstalling and reinstalling the app, and I've also restarted my phone, but nothings working. The game was actually good before this. I genuinely love the game, but now I can't play, which is lowkey depressing.
