I spend far too much time on this game. Following the most recent update, however, this is likely to change. The buddy section no longer loads, meaning that it will take longer to upgrade and will also deny "gifts" that it brings. It was bad enough that you decided that we couldn't play long distance raids, but this is ridiculous. Kinda defeats the object when you can't play the whole game. Thumbs down, Niantic.

The idea behind this game is revolutionary but Niantic Labs is rather incapable of implementing it well or lack the knowledge and resources to do so. When this game came out in 2016, it was a blast to play. The game had something incredibly new and fresh to offer. Though it had very limited gameplay features, it was overlooked as the game was fairly new. But now, even though 2 years have passed, the developers have failed to add something new except and few generations of new Pokemon, trading, raids and "Daily Tasks" and missions to keep their daily login numbers up. The game is very area biased so good luck playing this game if you live in an isolated part of the world.

Good game. Very fun and it does an awsome job of getting you out and about going on adventures. Even if your just stuck inside on a booring day, you can do remote raids or trainer battles. I've been playing this for years now. Every now and then I get GPS signal glitches but they fix in a few days. I think it would be cool to see a 2v2 mode come to the game some time soon though. Pokemon fashion shows would be pretty cool to see in the game too. Overall I rate it 4/5

2016 Very addictive. I can't log in half the time but when I can I can't fault the game. My dogs never been walked so much. New review. 2022 still playing on and off. My son is into it now. Sadly though I can't seem to upload pokestop scans, it just crashes and the adventure sync doesn't work for either of us. Other then that. Brilliant game. X

3 stars for now. You are going into right direction but still not there! You should add login bonus feature where you receive pokeballs or other items if you login each day in a row. Plus it would be more efficient if the app could work in the background. Because its basically a map app/game and you have a feature where you have to walk some distance to hatch an egg, it should be possible to have the game working in the background and tracking your movements (like endomondo or other location tracking apps).

Please create a rule so that players cannot take over a gym they have just been kicked out of within a certain amount of time. We have one local player who will appear (driving) within minutes of being kicked out of a gym, no matter the time of day, or location in our town, and take the gym back. It is making the game boring for other players, who are no longer getting any joy out of taking over gyms, and I will stop playing soon if this continues.

Have been playing since the game came out and never experienced any issues - until now. The latest update has screwed the game for me. I can no longer catch pokemon. If I have AR turned on I can't catch anything no matter how hard I try, and when I turn it off the game freezes and I have to force stop on the app. I have a OnePlus phone with Android. Please please fix this!!

Fun enough to play for a grind-based game, but there are plenty of bugs and support are notoriously unhelpful so beware. I had free items simply disappear over time which I let slide, but when a paid-for rare item failed to be added to one I'd keeping for months, Niantic refused to acknowledge that 1+1=2 and kept me at 1, despite agreeing I hadn't used one in recent history and claiming the new one had been added. So enjoy it, have fun, but don't expect to be respected by the developer.

Playing was fun at the start because of the steps-tracker. But not being able to TRACK a mon is beyond frustrating!! EDIT: New tracking system is worse! Showing ONLY Pokestops encourages driving if they are too far away, instead of walking to NEARBY pokemon. Can only track if near a Pokestop. Been playing since the beginning and am a dedicated player. If I didn't have a spawn spot in my house or work, I wouldn't play at all now. Please, BRING BACK TRACKING!!!

Niantic had implemented fantastic changes that made the game interesting and fun for players in rural areas or in situations that make travel/walking difficult. They have decided to turn their backs on all those players by prioritizing in-person raids and geolocation data. I am disappointed by these changes that make the wonderful Pokemon universe less accessible for a wide range of players (non-city folks). I will reinstall the game if Niantic shows consideration for its player base.

Pokemon Go has come along way since its beginning. It runs smoother, has more to do and the events are great. There is still alot of activity even in the smaller suburbs or towns and the seasonal roster and event roster pokemon are a great edition. My only complaint is that the character is the same for everyone. There are so many types of characters in the game from pokefans, scientists, bug catchers and fisherman. They should be entered as an avatar for players.

Tracker update, lack of communication, shut down of 3rd party apps, curve ball bonus removal. A lot of the things that made this game good have been thrown out of the window. EDITED IN 2019: The game has eventually gotten so much better and I have amended my review to reflect that. Its infinitely more stable than it was at release, trading, friends, raids and more pokemon than ever, while fixing pokemon tracking and the many bugs that were plaguing it in the beginning.

Like many others, I started this game in 2016 and dropped out of it just as the bugs continued to happen around that time. I came back to pogo in 2018 and had a blast till 2022. The game became stale. Remote raid passes because more expensive and limited and some players just don't use money for the game. Grinding in gyms was already hard enough. Disappointed that I will miss the friends I've made around the world. You know when was the best time for pogo? During covid. Use those updates.
daily eggs randomly get stuck at 1km then disappear sometimes. simultaneously using a lure and an incense only attracts a few pokemon

Greedy slimballs. Uninstalling game right now, I play the game mostly in the summer, as a way to get active. But the changes to the remote raids basically makes it unsustainable to play in the winter. If they wanted more activity in person, they could have left it at the 5 limit. But the fact that they raised the price, shows their intentions is greed. No consideration for players and different communities and region or safety. It's a global game, excludes major chunks of the population.

This is one of the best mobile games ever made. However it is not perfect, one problem I, and many others I know has is the types of pokemon in our area. I RARELY get anything other than pidgeys, ratattas and spearows and nothing else. Please could you increase the chance of getting better and rarer Pokemon as I get nothing but the same boring things. Also could you also add something that shows you the pokemon in that area rather than the sightings thing? Its kinda annoying.

Good game. I like the feeling of being able to catch Pokémon in real life, but there are a few things which mess it up for me. Pokémon don't spawn randomly anymore, only in specific locations. This makes it harder if you live nowhere near any pokéstops. Also, only higher leveled players can catch higher cp Pokémon, which annoys me because my friend is lv 26 and I'm only level 12. Overall the game is good, but a few changes should be made.(:

There is so much in this game now. But no kids play. Or at least not many. Mostly people in cars driving around taking gyms. Some days it's a pain but others not so much. I used to go for walks hours at a time with this game. But I had my fun. I just turn it on from time to time to set what's going on. Edit 2023 sep. Coin cost went up. The game is doing too many different events. Players are aggressive with gyms in my area. I think I need to move on. Most task require no walking. I want to walk.

It's fun at the start, you get new pokemon and keep going up and up the levels.. Then you get gyms to win money. But the problem is that the potion drop on pokestops are too rare, and sometimes I know leveling up gives you potions, but it's clearly not enough. And then you've certainly done the error of using all your incubators. The game wants you at some point to pay what you need. When you reach level 20, you see that you never get new pokemon, they're always the same ones.The game gets boring

Pretty fun game. However, you need to live in the center of big cities to get the most out of it. I can understand pokéstops being as they are now, but the logical thing would be having pokemon outside, in the actual wilderness... Can't play solo anymore, Gyms and raids require you team up with others, but when there is no one on your level around (everyone is at high levels nowadays it seems)...

I have been a dedicated player for many years, even though not everything has been as fun, like the first few years, I have continued to play daily! I have spent money and time all to have my Account hacked, and because I got 1 or 2 questions (questions that many can get incorrect!) I am no longer valid to confirm I am the owner of my own account, even if I present payment informations, pokemon and more. tried customer support, several times, all get told to make a new account... Just horrible

I am really enjoying the game and would love to give it a good rating, but I am constantly getting issues, crashing, freezing up and graphical issues too. These are all things that I can work around as they don't stop my progress. But the main issue I have, is Pokémon in gyms, they will be in there for 12 or more hours, get knocked then get knocked out. I'll get the notification to get pokecoins, but when I look, I haven't received any, this has happened a lot of times it's stopping me raiding.

I've been playing this game since day 1 and I have never before seen a game company so fit to be dunked on as this. Niantic have shown time and time again that they simply only care about getting money and gathering your data. Recent changes to their raid system and shop have made it impossible for many of the long term players to actively enjoy the game without spending ludicrous amounts of money. Do not download the game until these issues are addressed by Niantic (which they never will be)

This game has a lot of pull, it's pokemon, it's a GPS driven game that encourages you to get out and about. But, it's also a neolib nightmare, each update has something to encourage purchases. This is a company making over a billion in revenue from a server stack, an app and an IP licence. They don't need to keep rinsing their base or making gameplay harder for rural, disabled or immobile players. I really like the game, but the direction of development isn't great, but they keep making money...

There are many issues that compromise the fundamental enjoyment of the game. There needs to be some sort of tracking. It doesn't have to be a specific location but at least bring something in that allows you to know if you're getting close or too far away. Lack of variety of pokemon spawning in rural areas is an issue. The gym update means anyone can take a gym. The new buddy system is an attempt to stop you hoarding useful berries and getting rare candies more easily.

It has been 4 years since the game released and numerous features have been added such as raiding, trading and PvP. On the downside, Niantic has proven to be an incompetent and greedy company, introducing new bugs every update and not resolving bugs that have been around for ages, while also delaying or even blocking player progress behind a paywall. The game is great if you're a fan of Pokémon or have a group of friends/good community to play with. Otherwise, steer clear from this cash grab.

My old review was a little bitter and is now out of date, so here's a new one. I love the game and log in many times daily. Mostly due to my love of pokemon. The game has made me get more exercise, visit new places and make new friends, so it's achieved what the developers want. However, there are too many little issues that stop it getting 5* Mostly its trivial stuff, but there's enough of it to make it add up.

A fairly simple treasure hunting game that has opened up a whole new concept in mobile gaming. It's let down a little by the GPS battery drain so get an external battery pack. Trading, gifting friends and legendary Pokemon have all been added since launch. When in a new place following the stops takes you to lots of points of interest that you might otherwise miss. I can see this concept working for other franchises and I'm excited to see what comes next. Currently a good way to get out of the house.

There are still some frustrating stuff , that seem easy to fix and provide a better experience. Pokemon in gyms that are not challenged can stay there for months. There should be a way to claim them back. Less trade challenges please. Some of us don't have a lot of friends, who play the game, around. Also, pvp is pretty boring. Other than that, fun game.

Great game but there is a problem within it that's kind of laughable. If you were to buy PokeCoins with real money, its gets more expensive the more you buy, rather than cheaper for more as most games do. For example, 100 PokeCoins in .99c, yet 550 PokeCoins is roughly $7. The trend continues with higher values as well. As you can see, you get more value if you were to buy multiple at .99c. Really weird mechanic and so surprised it has not been changed yet.

Was a 5* game but Niantic have run the game into the ground. The game has been profusely limited in what you can do daily, or weekly. It has turned into a complete and utter pay to win game except the prices have skyrocket as well, and even then they have put a cap on how many raids you can do. With these new changes they have basically cut rural players, disabled players and players who have busy lives from the game point blank. I have uninstalled, and I certainly wouldn't recommend.

malfunctioning GPS is one thing, and not letting us log in is another, but to not even load the game and just stuck at the Niantic screen? This is a new low for an update error. I thought I've seen the worst this game has to offer, but turns out I'm wrong. I guess I won't be playing and discovering the new Sinnoh Pokémon and evolutions for a while.

Well, this is a great idea for a Pokemon game to have people going outside! But, the problem is that, in the new trading system, it costs way too much stardust, even as you level up friendship level, especially shinies, legendaries and new Pokemon. I would understand if it were around 50000-75000 stardust for good friends, but it is so much more! Also we need to implement trading items, please.

To be honest i didnt expect this. They added gyms and pokestops making it possible to have tons of pokeballs. When i quit the only thing you could do was to catch and to battle (in gyms) now you can trade, battle each other, send gifts to friends and more. An lastly but the most important change is that they added a variety of pokemon to my area making the game enjoyable. Overall the game became great for my area and i want to believe for other areas like mine.

The game is without a doubt nothing less than an eye opener to the outdoors. Ever since I installed this game, walking outside has never bothered me once. However, it is difficult to get anything from the PokeStops since they are so scattered. The nearest PokeStops is at least 10km from my home and I have little access to such locations, and walking 5km has started to become more and more difficult as summer began. Also, its impossible to address this to anyone in the Pokemon GO developers, wth.

It's a lot of fun game. I enjoy that I 've get out my room and search for new pokemons. The new feature, trainer battle is owesome. But, I've found its difficult to find other trainers nearby. It will be so much easier and helpfull if you add some feature like a radar to detect where is the other trainer around and also we (players) can challenge them without say hello to them (in real). It is weird sometimes that you have to make contact with strangers only to playing a game. Thank you.

I couldn't even get onto the app. It would load, and then I'd try to make an account and it would take to long to load. I would leave my phone on for hours, and the app wouldn't load the screen where I could make an account with Google. I don't like the apps overall experience either. Groudons are extremely hard to catch, and you can't find any starter pokemon. The only other time I found so thing else was the eevees. This app is a waste of time, and a waste of space.

The playing mechanics are great for a mobile game and the concept finally got me to excersise willingly. However like for most other players, the servers are down half the time (or more). Knowing the amount of hype this game had before release, the servers should've been prepared for something like this. Please fix this issue as I personally find it the only thing from seeing Pokemon GO as a 5-star app.

Functionally the game works. Purchases are still hit and miss. The rewards road doesn't work at all and support doesn't respond. Why have a web store when it only loads the home page and not the store.

The game itself is very good, but when you want to log back in or create another account, it keeps asking you for an "adult" email address for a child account, but as soon as you want to create your adult account, they still show you have to enter a parent's email address. It's illogical and totally annoying. I wanted to play again for the nostalgia, but the desire quickly disappeared as soon as I struggled for more than 15 minutes. So good luck.

Its the same game for so many years. Nothing good ever happens n. Progress is so slow, It's feels like monotonous work on a monday and its all for the sake of a cash grab for niantic. From being a hardcore player now i've just limited the game to community day's, get a shiny and done till the next one. Keep an alarm on the phone, keep a lure for 1/2 or 1 hour and get like 1-3 shines and done. If it wasnt for this i wouldnt even open the game anymore. The focus to reward ratio is too less.

I used to love playing pokemon go and I still play it now, but more and more features exclude players in remote areas. Thinking about raiding (at least we have remote Raids now) and now the next one the routes. I am living on an island with a couple of gyms and about 20 pokestops, we finally were able to create routes ourselves but it's taking forever to get them approved, I feel like the game has turned into an app where the money making has priority over the actual enjoyment of the players.

It used to be good but Niantic went full predatory mode. Their prices keeps coming up (from 100 to 195 tokens for remote raids. That's stupidly huge). They offer special loot boxes with better rewards but only if you don't have enough token so you're forced to buy if you want the deal. If you have a lot of tokens tho, you can't have that deal... They don't care about their player base. I don't recommend playing this game.

Love the game for someone like myself but upon thinking about it the mechanics of it make it incredibly uninclusive , I know that's cryptic but unfortunately the character limit means I can't go into full detail about the issue, I even had helpful suggestions on how you could fix the issue and still have the game be entirely fair for all players. As its not really fair to point out something such as that without thinking it through yourself. Anyways. That's my review. Probably no one cares lol.

Laggy and Ruined! I have been a player from day one, took about a year hiatus but came back because it seemed more user friendly. Found out recently some player have been able to use third party apps to get better Pokémon which is straight up cheating. And to make matters worse, they penalize players who play the game like Pokémon is supposed to be played by raising prices on already expensive necessities. Can't even be bothered to increase the amount you get for placing Pokémon on gyms! GREEDY!

Overall game is fun, but this review is to address the go fest. Really disappointed in this years fest. The price of the ticket is triple last years price, and the amount of content was far less. There were countless bugs that made it infuriating to play for many players, and the rate of shinies felt like they were far lower than previous year's go fest. A lot of people online are feeling ripped off by this annual event, and I really hope that Niantic addresses this in the coming weeks.
the game keeps freezing when I try to select a new egg to hatch

Edited*** Was a 5 star review. Was a whale, spending thousands over the last few years. But after some changes they announced today, I will be uninstalling. Biggest is increasing the price of fundamental in game items by double the previous price, and putting a limit. The items in question are remote raid passes, which are required if you want to raid with friends that are elsewhere, or just to fill your lobby as many raids need 4+ people. This will effectively destroy a main aspect of the game

The updates are a constant bother. Lucky I gave you 1 star. Glad I'm not alone. This game was great but over the years of playing it's just got harder and harder unless you invest $$$ and that's just low. I was thinking on reinstall but after reading some of the most critical reviews not a chance! I've mentioned the battery issue just after it was released and still nothing done. That's a serious issue. Who wants to be charging there phone every five minutes? Shame on you money hungry monkeys.

Additions made due to the pandemic actually made the game better and more wide-ranging. However now Niantic wants people to go back in time to before the pandemic, when their game had a blossoming in person community. Those times are gone now. They have raised prices, made in store boxes garbage, and are trying to force players to go back to the way things were. They are now focusing attention on another IP & don't seem to care about the game that made them recognizable. Just a cash cow

The only thing this game has going for it is the Pokemon IP. There is literally nothing good about this game right now. It has potential, but there are currently only 2 ways to play this game. The first is to walk around aimlessly and hoping you get lucky going within 200m range of a rare Pokemon, and the second is to sit at a cluster of lures without moving. Neither is exciting. The nearby list needs to show rarer Pokemon at a longer range with more tools to track down the Pokemon.

I've been four years without playing it and because the game seems more attractive now, I'm back. But Niantic isn't really trying to adapt it in regards to Covid-19 quarentine. You could at least give us a few pokeballs for logging in. I don't live next to a pokestop and because I can't get Cobalion as a Go Battle reward (0 pokeballs), I can't battle, either. Basically I can't play it and I'm pretty sure lots of people around the world are facing the same situation.

It seems a fun game, it brings me back to my childhood but it has a big flaw. In order for the pokemon to appear while you walk you have to be connected to a network which consumes lodes of data if you're without wifi network. After a first "test drive" on the streets in places where I was sure I had good internet connection the game crashed while catching pokemon, I lost the pokemon and the balls used on them. Please fix these bugs.

The only game I like to play. Lots to do and fun But there are to many glitches and errors and lately the game has become automated, makes the experience feel less real. Which ultimately makes it just another game. A month ago it wasn't like that. Catching Pokémon in Raids are also a no go. You will get 1 out of every 5 battles. Gets expensive.

So far so good. The graphics and gameplay, though simple, is surely addicting and enjoyable. It lags some of the time maybe because of my mobile connection. Im waiting for the new tacking system and the IV calculator. I am also looking forward for the 2nd generation pokemon to come out. Keep it up Niantic! 1/8/2021 I am trying to get back to the game when I heard you can now level up to 50. Its still fun, more tasks and things to do. But why do I feel like this has been a pay to win game?

Great game and pioneer in AR technology. I rated it 4 stars based on its potential of being a great game in the future. I Love the concept of bringing gamers out to parks and making them cooperate in a battle (i.e. legendary raids). For now, several features such as battle gameplay, pvp, and pokemon development (training, breeding) are either missing or must be improved. It could bring more gamers in if we can add more tactical depth in combat rather than just making them tap to death. Besides, this can make people give up on having multiple accounts without the counter-productive ban waves. 😉

The game is great in general but I've found a few fundamental issues with trading that could be improved. There is no warning in game that you cannot trade back your Pokémon, therefore causing me to lose one of my best ones when attempting to get a lucky Pokémon. This is poor game design and user experience. This could be solved by allowing trade backs, with possibly a cool down of 30 days so as to not take advantage. Also needs a popup warning before confirming trade.

Niantic actively makes it harder for people to play the game by pushing in person play features and making it harder to play remotely (less incense spawns when stationary, remote raid pass prices going up). If you live in a rural environment, are disabled, or even if there's really bad/dangerous weather outside, you can't play at all. This does not make for an inclusive game and overall the changes push people away rather than bring them together.

I've played this since it was released officially in the UK. Since then, it's gained so many features that are fundamental to Pokemon, that it is essentially a fully fledged Pokemon game in its own right, rather than a quick money grabber. It occasionally suffers reliability issues but those tend to get resolved soon after, and it's adapted well to lockdown measures from COVID. Overall, if you like Pokémon, there's no reason to miss out on playing this.

I've been a dedicated Pokémon Go player for years, but the recent price increase of Remote Raid Passes is really disappointing. These passes were a great way to stay connected with friends and participate in raids from anywhere, especially during the pandemic. Now, with the higher prices, it feels like the game is becoming less accessible for many players. I hope Niantic reconsiders this decision and makes the game more affordable again!

I've been playing this a lot, while partaking in my daily walks out and about the neighborhood. I've not been a Pokefan much in the past but really feel like this game rewards you for getting out and doing some exercise. Like the Ingress game it's based on, there's strategic locations around your neighborhood you can visit to find resources, that you can use to capture Pokémon and to improve the ones you have. You don't have to fight other people if you don't want to either, which is nice.

It's a fun, annoying game. There is always something different happening. I do believe in order to catch "rare" or "cool" pokemon should be more of an option. It deffinitly is a game to get you outside, walking and moving while having fun. As someone who knows absolutely nothing about pokemon, I do enjoy this game and it definitely has the ability to continue growing to be better.

Great game if you have like 5 or 6 friends nearby to play with. Right now you don't even have to be close, just coordinate yourselves. It would be nice to communicate within the game tho. There's people i got on my friend list that i only know from there, and sometimes i would like to send a message like "raid in 10min" or something similar.

This one of my favorite games and I play it daily. But there is one problem I face a lot that is there is no option to message your PoGo friends which will make it really good as we can discuss and open gifts and ask for battles in the game itself. And one more is that there should be a option to put a mesaage at the time of raids also so that people can see that and join our lobby as sometimes many people are doing the raids and want to join the lobby and are not able to do.

Good Game, but has some issues which have taken me to write this review. First, the distribution of poke stops and gyms throughout the land is truly bad for those that live in villages or less crowded areas. I understand that makes more sense to have more where are more players, but try to spread some interesting spots each Km. Secondly, remove the limitation of 50 coins for the first day at a gym. Took over a gym in my village and haven't been able to neither get my pkmn back or get coins.

Oof. The reduced reach distance is really impacting the gameplay. We're supposed to avoid crowded spaces and yet at the same time get right on top of each pokestop? So many pokestops and gyms are in the middle of buildings or in private places, and are now yet again unreachable. My other complaint- outside of events, we get the same 10 pokemon appear in the wild and that's it. No more surprise of stumbling into something rare... I don't feel motivated to explore anymore when it's all the same.

It's much better than it was at launch, with a ton of things to do, trainers to battle, pokés to hatch. But you're screwed if you don't find a large, active community in your town. You NEED people for endgame content. Not only that, but there are still issues which Niantic won't address - like updating existing PokéStops/Gyms, adding new ones etc.

Basically it's like one of those pet collecting games but with AR and Pokémon. The game really only focuses on collecting Pokémon and trading them. There are some combat mechanics but it really leaves a lot to be wanted. There's not really much you can do with your Pokémon, trade or use them to fight which doesn't do much to them really. The game lacks a clear direction and just follows a more pokemon is better mentality without ever fixing gameplay mechanics or adding needed ones. Plus BUGS!

Downloaded this game in 2016 and played it all the time. After a while I uninstalled it as it didn't appeal to me as much. Yet here I am in 2021 writing a review. As you can probably already tell by this review I have reinstalled it recently and I must say, the game has not lost its touch. There are several new features and updates I never imagined would be part of Pokémon go and there are still so many things to do. Also my progress was not deleted despite a 4-5 year break. 5 stars 100%.

Great game. I love finding Pokémon, catching them and occasionally trying to beat a gym or raid. It's fun to play with my friends and we can trade, send gifts and even battle! However, it would be cool to add a feature where (if the player allows it) you can see if friends are online and maybe where they are so you can meet and play together. I think another good feature would be a messaging system so you can message friends who are online to ask to meet or trade etc.

Game is improving, as the "pay to win" feel at the same time. It will be interesting to see what happens next after the introduction of gen3. Battle, gyms and raiding system dynamics are incredibly simple and in desperate need of some depth. The weather influence was a good addition, but abilities will be needed at a certain point (i.e. soon). 95% of the pokemons are currently mere dex fillers with no actual use in the battle metagame.

Been playing since 2017 overall it's been a fun game to play. But more and more it feels like a pay to win. You can only really make the most out of the game if you have a very specific set of conditions. Gyms and pokestops near you, friends to play with and money to spare. Bugs are a minor problem aswell. Might install again if niantic makes some adjustments.

From playing this game, you will find many advantages despite little disadvantages. One of the advantages such as your health will be better as you are walking around to find a pokemon so it consider as exercise. Then, you can make a new friends when finding pokemon or at pokestop and gym. Anyway, got a little bugs that need to be fix but overall, this game is awesome.

Garbage, works purely on addiction factor and constant events trying to pull you in due to fear of missing something rare. Very little actual gameplay and mostly just going around hoping to get lucky. Loves to waste your time by making you spend 3-5 minutes tapping the screen in one place to "fight" a raid, then makes the catch rate so low you'll probably not catch the thing afterwards anyway. I'm giving it an extra star because the Pokémon are cute.

The game is great, but one problem. I am always a passenger and can't get out much to place that have any stops or gyms I do catch stops just fine (there aren't any in my area, I need to go far for them) But gyms, when I was in a driving car I wanted to fight in a gym, the battle was about to start but what I can only assume to be from the fact we went too far, the game threw me out of the battle was said "The gym is completed " despite me not even getting to tap a single hit. Pls fix

5* when one fatal flaw is fixed! I think it's incredibly cool how much this game improves and the developers clearly respect their player base and have made updates based on feedback alone. My main complaint is that sometimes, if I'm in a pokemon confrontation and I use a berry on the pokemon, when I go to throw a ball it isn't responsive. I can leave the battle though, and close the game but can't select anything in the battle or be able to throw a ball! I've lost some good pokemon due to this.

I can never put my pokemon in the gym. The players in this neighbourhood camps and kicks you out the moment it's not one of them. It's frustrating not being able to play, some people can take in all the coins while others can barely get anything. Its not a great feeling to have while playing, much like bullying. Maybe input a better capping system to help the spread more fairly. Overall it's still fun to catch things casually.

I think its good. Quite a good game to do while going out for minutes then going back home to stay in quarantine. But issues is lately. I had duplicates of the same pokémon in the area. Could try and make it so its less the same. And also hand out some codes so people can use them for items. Never be greedy for cash if we all stuck inside.

I've been playing since the beginning (2016). The game has tons of bugs and glitches, predatory pricing for in game items, a high focus on in real life experiences that are costly and unplayable due to bugs and server issues. On top of that, Niantic lately is removing game play options like it by the community, leaving behind a disappointed and unheard community. I won’t recommend you to download the game until Niantic resolve core issues with the game.

I've been playing since day one and used to love this game, but it's kinda miserable now, esp as a mainly free to player these days. Everything is so expensive, either in time or money and so much is locked behind paywalls (or was & is no longer accessible now, sorry new players!) I like to exercise. i love to walk and run and this game was great for that, but I've found myself just putting my phone away and not caring anymore. Bugs & predatory prices & exclusionary practices have made it suck

A little irked at this app's performance lately. It randomly shuts down and occasionally I can't move anything on the screen or tap on anything, causing me to miss catching the Pokémon because I had to restart the app. (edit: oh, now it's freezing on me too. I can't even access my items! 😡) I also kinda find it stupid how you need to buy more storage for both Pokémon and Items, although it does give people a reason to go beat each other's gyms.

A nice and interesting game, but I don't enjoy it quite as much as I would like to. This review is all bias. I enjoy the actual Pokémon games a lot. This one is different, and that is fine. However I don't see it competing with the other games. It's just a collecting game that depends on your location. Raids are a nice addition but ultimately boring. Same goes for trainer battles. There is no achievement in it for me, and basically no involvement either. Also it breaks a lot on my phone.

Game has gone downhill fast in the past 6 months. It's clear the game is not the focus for Niantic, it's simply a way to to collect and monetize location based player data. The game is getting more and more buggy, only the things important to gathering data get fixed quickly, the rest may or may not be dealt with in the future. Too bad, the game used to be fun.

Overall, my experience with Pokemon GO has been rather positive. However, I recently experienced a very frustrating situation twice: I joined a raid through an invite (using the remote raid pass, which costs 195 coins, so at least four days of collecting), everything was cool until the game simply kicked me out of the raid, making it impossible for me to catch pokemon. Of course, I couldn't rejoin the raid.

Dear Niantic, pokemon go is a great game. My girlfriend and I love the game, we play it everywhere. I have a few ideas that would be good for the other players and the game it's self. 1. Make trading anywhere as Long as your best friends. 2. Able to see your friends when they are close by, say 10-20ft away. 3. See what team is battling with you in a gym. 4. Able to message any of your friends when it shows they are online.

Nothing like what I'm used to in the video games. You can't use just any pokémon of any species because there are ones that are strickly worse than another of the same species. So you could spend forever looking for a single species that is the best it could be. When you do finally find the strongest one you then have to catch even more pokémon of that species to level it up. Not battling like in the games. It's nearly impossible to beat raids without many others playing with you. You can't really interact with your pokémon in anyway. So all you do is walk around and catch pokémon, the same ones, over and over again. Boring. Also trading resets pokémon stats which makes no sense. I don't understand why they made it this way. It easily could have been like a virtual pet system where you interacted with your pokémon. But nope.

Unfortunately I give up on playing because it turned too messy, there is no tools enough to manage the Pokémons, checking, comparing before release and clean the boxes, you actually have to open one by one to check their status, and nobody has time for it anymore. The lack of simple tools are impressive. And I'm sure this are in proposed because they try you to buy more and more storage.

Severe lack of content and new Pokemon. Rate of new Pokemon being released is about 3 every 6 months. Maybe. Edit: Came back to playing after a few years and the same problems this game always had is still present. Niantic absolutely preys on people's fear of missing out (FOMO) and gameplay is just as bare as it was 2 years ago. This game is absolutely carried by the Pokemon name and Niantic knows this, which is why they can get away with doing the bare minimum and still turn up a profit.

I've been playing this since 2016 and is the only mobile game I've ever truly enjoyed playing and have used for longer than a year. I'll admit, I'm a bit of a sucker for Pokemon, considering it was my first ever video game with Yellow back in 1999/2000. But the mechanics of the game when released was a massive bit of fresh air for the franchise and gave a new challenge to play. Research tasks, trainer xp, legendary raids, gyms, battling, new gens released each year. ABSOLUTELY ADDICTIVE 5*

This is an amazing game. I love the fact that they actually majorly updated the game, releasing a new menu, pokemon, backgrounds, levels, and so much more. I'm not a fan of the limited item/pokemon storage, as it can get pesky to constantly delete or purchase more storage. Overall it's a great game and I'd definitely recommend it to anyone looking to go outside and catch their favorites

Actually, i enjoy it. But, can you put add friends tools or chat in the gym? We want to keep the gym, but sometimes, we not connected each other, and we cannot add friend in the gym. We just know who the trainer was. So, if you put add friends tools on the gym, it will be nice. Or maybe, put chat tools to? It will be perfect. Thanks before.

The main point of the game, the Adventure Sync, breaks constantly and none of their solutions work. It won't even let you turn ON the Adventure Sync even when you've granted all the relevant permissions, it's not a problem of the user not granting the right settings, it's the app just being broken. It literally WILL NOT LET YOU and sometimes it won't even let you log on. I don't know what's happened but this game is becoming rapidly unplayable

I've been playing this game almost since it was released and now, after such a long time I can finally admit that it's one of the most entertaining mobile games I've ever played! There are still several cons of course, such as primitive gym battles mechanics and Pokemon spawning system fostering major cities with lots of PokeStops, but in general I'm amazed with the great amount of work that Niantic has undertaken to make players' experience much more vivid and joyful.

I started to experience difficulties loading the game, kept getting a red bar at the top of the screen, telling me it could not find GPS signal. I have a brand new phone and have installed the latest Pokemon version from play store. Niantic.support gave me instructions to help correct the problem, nothing worked, so now unable to access the game.

I have been playing PGO since launch, despite a rocky start, I have had an excellent experience playing this game. only complaint would be raids. As great an idea as they are, it forces those who play alone to play with others to get certain pokemon. Despite some of these pokemon being available through research tasks later on in the game, it doesn't provide a great experience for those who prefer to play alone.

It's better now! As of it's kinda available in Bangladesh, right now 🤞🏻 but still, no better Pokemons, very few of them are powerful like 3 stars, and the game is just not playable in F2P mode. It's really hard to progress if you're a F2P player. Not enough storage for items, only 300 Pokemons can be caught! Considering this, and the game itself, it's kinda okayish. I hope the devs are concerned about it!

I like the game. Although the game kind of defeats the original purpose of the older and slightly better games. Usually, you'll have side quests and have a larger amount of items to put in your inventory. Also, both evolving Pokèmon and catching legendaries are waaayy too easy. Am I getting rid of the game though? No. Why? Because it's Pokèmon. Who wouldn't want to opportunity to see a Mudkip in your bedroom looking at you :)

The core concept of the game is amazing. The developers are out of touch. Bugs are common, especially in Australia. Can't even get in the game without a few restarts. Cost to play of going up a lot too. $7 for a single pokemon and a 95% increase in cost for remote raiding. Meanwhile, the amount of resources needed to max s pokemon are insane.

The game is a total mess with regular bugs in it. Not to mention the absolute dumpster fire of a "new avatar update" that is released in the latest update! There is no feedback from Niantic. They just want their money, and the player base can go jump in the river for all that they care. It's not the same game from 2016-2019. It's not worth the time and money to put in this game!

It was fun, but now there are some issues while battling which have never been fixed and it is clear that Niantic or whomever the fork it is does not care to reward players. If tou are going to raise item's prices you might also raise the ability of extendig the amount of maximum coins that you can earn per day to 100. Within the area I live I have three different gyms within a 5 km area, so being able to do raids with my friends from all over the world really helped me, now it is too expensive.

Great Game if you like Pokemon in gerneral. With this app you go out, find new people who also play the game and build friendships. Also just meeting up at raids is also a good feature to find new people. Being able to evolve Pokemon with candy is pretty cool too. The only thing that bothers me ist that in small towns there aren't really Pokemon and Pokestops. So I would appreciate better spawns for small towns or not setting the spawns to "activity" around that area. So Players who don't live in a City have the same possiblity to catch Pokemon.(Also more Pokestops in would be great)

I know I am late to the trend, but from this game's popularity and age, I had expected major gamebreaking bugs to be ironed out by now. The game won't even let me catch the starter pokemon - I keep getting an error saying item can't be used. Worst part is support has been non-existent. I only get an automated response thanking me for reporting the bug and that they will not deal with my case personally...then what is the point? I made a second report as a login issue, but got no response either.

Interesting game with serious flaws due to extremely uneven distribution of stops and gyms. It's discouraging to play this game in Africa. There are hardly any pokestops, even in capital cities. The nearest gym is over 300 km away. The wayfarer system doesn't offer a solution either; proposals can be made but nothing happens in a year or more. Very disappointing

Edit: I'll bump my rating back up to 5 stars when they iron out the stability issues this update has brought. Endlessly spinning pokeballs of doom have cost me a dozen pokemon so far. Niantic has steadily improved this game since it was released, addressing bugs and adding features, like a good game publisher should. This is the second game I've spent money on, an honour that I do not bestow lightly. It's not perfect, I'm not pleased with the gift nerf that just happened, but it is the longest running game on my phone.

Update: quit the game about a year ago. No regrets. Nothing fun happens and if something fun does you need to pay to play. Literally. I would go back if it was worth it but hearing from recent threads it does not seem like that is the case. Disappointing :( glitchy and boring. Still brings me back but they are only doing 40% of what could potentially be done. Im only staying because i want to see this game reach its potential

I have loved and played this game for some years now. Never had any problems or bad encounters until two days now. I am participating in remote raids and when it is time to catch the Pokémon I have glitches indicating that I have indeed caught it after the 3rd spin and then it breaks in. The same issue in multiple raids. The support does, nothing. Nonchalant bot related answers with no suggestions or improvements. After all the support and money we invest as players they do not care for us!!!!

l absolutely loved this game as I've always loved pokemon, however, i wished there were more variations of skills. It becomes very repetitive and can become quite dull at times, if there was more to the game than just walking around and battling (such as style options) then it would be far more enjoyable in my opinion. Regardless though, it is a very good game with a lot of depth.

I hate leaving this game a bad review, but I'm hear again:(. First of all since the new update I drift a lot. I'm never where I'm supposed to be witch is annoying when I'm right by a gym ect and it's saying I'm across the road or out of range. The steps counter is still not reading properly. I did 27 mile the other day and it didn't read 15 of those miles. I've also noticed that it doesn't always register tasks e.g. hatch 5 eggs, make a great throw ect and I'll have to do them until it does.

Been playing this game a lot more recently and it's safe to say, I love it. I'm finding a bigger variety of pokemon now in the same places I used to find purely Ratatas and Pidgeys. Game used to crash, freeze and loose connection all the time but now I've noticed it is so much better! I've not had the game freeze on me while I'm trying to catch a pokemon since the summer when it first came out. Love the buddy feature as it enables me to only have to find one (dratini) to be able to get more candies for it.

This game hasn't changed in the nearly 10 years it's been out. Think how outdated some of the mechanics are after nearly a decade! Everything 'new' Niantic implements is a reskin of something they've done before. Plus the money grabbing that's become so prevalent in the last couple years. Niantic are one of laziest, greediest developers in the field- they'd be right at home with EA...

First couple of days are really fun, but it quickly becomes pay-to-play, which is my most hated free-to-play style! What point is a game if you can't play it? Hugely disappointed. Would've possibly spent some money on skins/new pokemon, but not being able to catch pokemon or join battles after a few days 'trial' is stupid! The correct way to go with this style of game would be to have paid skins and speedups to reduce the time taken to hatch pokemon, or even buy. I simply cannot recommend.

great game overall, the developers are lovely and keep the playerbase active through events. they're generous with pokeballs and items needed to enjoy, a part from egg hatching you do realistically have to throw some money at if you want to hatch a lot, but this is not a necessity. there are some great bundles that come up from time to time which can be nice to pick up. you can also earn game currency through play so you don't necessarily need to spend money if you're a patient person. 5/5

I want to hop on here with others who are trying to be heard and mention the lack of care and respect from those who run the app. This distasteful attitude unfortunately leaches into the actual game, over years and months making it harder and less fun to play. [e.g less remote raids, free gift boxes] It comes across as greedy, and I know players are struggling. The game is cool, but it's getting worse and worse, and so are the people running it.

Loving playing this so far. Would be good if you could use a pokemon assigned to a gym to view the gym when youre out of range. (edit- they added this) Also friends, (edit- added) pvp (edit- also added)and fix the tracking. (edit- yea...sort of) I want to be able to find the pokemon nearby instead of wandering randomly till i find it. Overall im gonna be playing more. I like the walking im doing and its something else to drag my boyfriend out into the day star.

Fun game now as new content is being delivered frequently, however, I would still prefer if the original tracker were brought back. Previous review - 2016/17 Product cannot be used as advertised due to game functionality problems as of recent update. At launch the game was fun with a tracking system. Tracking was glitched so players resorted to 3rd party maps and tracking services. Now neither work. Barely average game at best, with a lower radius to scan for Pokémon, no ability to track, and few PokéStops for players outside of major cities. Needs serious improvement or it will lose a majority of it's player base. #FixTracker

As a concept I think this is brilliant, having Pokemon overlaid on the real world is a neat idea. My kids love playing it and big bonus is they are getting outdoors, along with hundreds of others, I have even registered my own account. Bug fixes / updates are reasonably frequent. Still playing 4 years on, my kids have given up but it makes a daily walk a bit more interesting and some catches have become souvenirs of my travels.

Great.... When it works. Most recent update has completely ruined the gameplay though. I track my runs on two other apps at the same time, and both show I've run ~12 km this past week, with another 5 k walking. All while Pokemon Go was open, yet Pokemon Go registered a total of 1.7k. literally 1/10th the reality. It also freezes frequently, and drains battery more than any other app I've ever used. But this distance tracking is enough to finally force me to uninstall.

The game itself is really good. I've been playing it for around 4 years. But in my opinion, the bag limit should get removed. I participate in raids often, I do a lot of quests also and my item bag gets bigger and bigger each time. I don't have money to upgrade my bag. My bag reached around 1000/350 items, so I'm pretty frustrated that I can't pariticipate in league battles no more because I can't claim the item rewards.

just a casual player which opens this game whenever they go out. As a casual game I think this game is great for pokemon lovers. I so far have had no problems with the game crashing and no glitches. But in reality I think the addition to scan pokestops is just something you dont want to be seen doing in real life. And also the system whereby in tracks distance for hatching eggs is fairly inaccurate.

Played on and off since 2016, but based on the decisions made by Niantic in the last six months alone, that switch is permanently off. Price-gouging, buggy events, lackluster pokemon pools, constant nerfs to qualify of life features, terrible Ex raid system, the list goes on. Uninstalled for legitimately the first time since release. Doubt I'll come back as there's no way Niantic isn't fully aware of what they're doing. They just don't care anymore.

I've loved this game for years. It is honestly my escape from reality. The problem is sometimes the app locks you out, or says it cannot authenticate you. That's just depressing because so much effort has been put into your profile over the years. The fear of losing your hard earned Pokémon is quite stressful. I'm currently having that issue and hoping it gets resolved through reinstalling.

Bland and grindy - it really is nothing but a chore. The things you do everyday is more or less the same, and the grinding part is ugly. Achievements take too much efforts to obtain! Some requires you to catch 1000 of the same thing, some straight up asks 15000 of hours in this already boring game, some unlocks rare items *in the shop*, meaning you still have to buy with premium currency to get that reward! There are other games that motivate you to walk - don't play this one.

Its fun here and there, but it's meh. The game sets out to be what it is. But it could be alot better if more was brought to it, or even if features that they have now removed still remained. Like many of other reviews will tell you, the covid update added ease to the game and more reason to play it. Pulling back on those additions wasn't a great move. The games not quite as heartless as some of the hard review bombs will tell you however, atIeast in my opinion .

Been playing this for some time now, they keep adding things to make you come back to it although the last month has been a little slow. The major floor I have found being someone who doesn't know very many people around me who play the game that it is going to be and has been impossible for me to complete tasks and pokedex when I cant battle 5 star raids as 1 or 2 people. Feels a bit unfair for those that are less social than others...

A really fun casual game, but its unfortunate how difficult some raids are as you can only beat them with other people, which can be difficult if you don't know anyone to play with or live in a small area with not a lot of other players. General gameplay is fun still and the more popular raids can be joined remotely so there is still the opportunity to beat them.

No real customer support whatsoever. I've been playing this game since the day it came out, took a break and then returned. As I've done in the past I decided to purchase pokecoins to help things along but because the game is so unstable now, during the transaction an error occurred which caused me to be double billed. I was able to get one transaction refunded through Google Play. However Niantic also removed the coins from my account despite taking my money. Since then they've refused to help.

A really fun game to play. I like it so much! 5 stars 😀 edit: I think Niantic needs to start working on fixing some bugs, but even if they don't fix them for a long time, I still will have this review 5 stars because it's always a fun game to play. Pokemon Go is the best! 👍👍👍 Also here are a few suggestions: 1. Add pokestops in rural areas. 2. Add more characters for tags.

Gameplay is still fresh for the most part. A few questionable decisions quite a bit (example) research breakthrough = Trapinch.... Right after Trapinch was an event day with shinies quite common. Love the effort made to keep the game fun during lockdown. Keep up the good work, I look forward to the latest updates as the game expands further.

Great game, heaps of fun building up the Pokedex but I (and many others) would love to see an update that focuses on rural areas within our communities. Things I think would improve the game, that do not include adding extra pokestops, would be things such as pokemon spawning next to you like the incense mechanic, even if it's only 1 random pokemon every 3 hrs. Random wild spawn locations that move and are not fixed to a single location so you might encounter a random pokemon at home (if lucky).

Still enjoyable but certainly needs a lot of quality of life updates. Having to perpetually buy bag and Pokémon storage is a chore, you should be able to still swipe pokestops for the xp even if your bag is full. The 50 coins a day limit is too little, 100 would be ideal. The variety in Pokémon in the wild still isn't great. Limitations on trading is unfair and the inability to do anything with friends far away is restricting, especially when you can't complete the Pokédex if you can't travel.

I love the idea of this game but the gameplay is pretty tedious: trading gifts is a chore, the app takes a couple minutes to load on my phone, catching pokemon takes way too long, etc. I can't play in-person, the way Niantic wants, because I have no local friends who play anymore. I'm just tired of doing all the things daily. And then they make remote raids more expensive and more tedious. No thanks. I'm out.

The game used to be good, now after years, it is slow, still has quite a lot of bugs and a lot of features require spending money to be actually useful. The biggest problem being that you can catch whatever pokemon Niantic wants, and does not require you to walk to find the pokemon you want. A lot of the Pokemons are behind paywalls and you or locked behind a certain mechanic.

I really enjoy the game, I play it every day so dont get me wrong. But the sinnoh stone update is too difficult to get. Especially in a smaller town where pokestops and gyms are very limited so finishing research in an actual week is rare. There should be a way to get more pokestops in smaller areas without having to play ingress. Side note: almost every community day is glitchy. I've planned out my community day too many times just for it not to happen.

In-app purchases have risen by 95%. Makes daylight robbery seem attractive. Been playing this game since its release date and have never witnessed anything like this before. Penalising the mobility challenged community even more by limiting what they can and cant do in a game... A GAME!!!! Nope. No more for me, done with Niantic and their greedy ways.

It would be five stars if there wasn't a major glitch in the game that is becoming increasingly frustrating. Whenever I click on a pokemon to initiate a battle (usually rarer mons) I get presented with just a white screen, and then I can't catch pokemon for a couple of hours after because all I get is a white screen. It used to be every so often, and I didn't really mind, but bow it's almost every time I try and use the app.

A game that used to be top tier, and brought all types of players together, has sadly fallen into what seems like a corrupt scheme catering to only 1 type of player. While the casual player may still find some enjoyment in Pokemon GOandSpendMoney, they will constantly feel like they're missing out on a huge chunk of the game. Niantic lacks the Instinct to listen to it's players, and without the Valor to make changes, they'll turn you into a Mystic questioning why you still play Pokemon GO.

Game was great but they increased the price to raid remotely almost double. This severely hurts you completing 5 star raids. Would take 4 24hr periods of staying in a gym to get enough coins. Would not recommend if you cannot travel to gyms. Only meant for people that can spend the time to travel around your town. Do not download if you live in a remote area, are disabled, limited time due to family, work, or lack of transportation. Niantic does not listen to its player base. No one wanted this.

I've thoroughly enjoyed this game I've even spent quite a bit of real money on it but the only thing that's bugging me is that since the raid battles became existent. I haven't been able to fight the pokemon. It loads and the countdown happens but as soon as it hits zero there's a connection error and I've missed out on legendary and equally rare pokemon alike.

I have been playing this game for a long time. The game is really great especially the "remote pass" that I can play with friends from abroad. but now, things have changed. they deliberately frame certain events like raids, so some are harder to get but claim they are all the same as your leech money. The price will be increased this April, if you have a family playing this game please keep them away from this app especially your children.

A few issues, 1) when I try to catch a pokemon sometimes it doesn't allow me to use any ball to catch it. This has become a fairly regular thing where restarting the game is the only way to sort it and I miss out on the pokemon. 2) a similar problem where sometimes when I join a raid it doesn't actually let me battle so I can take damage but can't attack them myself. This has led to missing out on catching some good pokemon and losing my raid passes too. Please sort it out.

Played since day one, from the get go it was obvious Niantic built this game to be a cash cow and they never cared. At a certain point the game gets extremely repetitive and the amount of content - very limited. It feels like there is no point to waste weeks getting a pokemon that's 1% better. And for what? Hackers can do the same in minutes.

Please please please change the feature with the gifts where I have to scroll allll the way down to send/receive the next gift. Before, when we sent and received gifts, went back to the screen with the list of friends, we could pick up where we left now. Now, if I skip a friend's gift (to wait for ultra or best friends) and continue to send/receive gifts and go back to the "list of friends" page, it send me back allll the way up to the FIRST person that sent me a gift. This makes it a real big pain to keep scrolling down. Leveling up friendships through gifts already took long enough. With this update, it takes 3 times longer to finish sending gifts.

It's a great game, although it does have a few issues. 1. Just recently I haven't received any coins from defending gyms, even though one was for over a week. 2. The fact that some of the pokemon are region specific is a joke, it makes it pretty much impossible to collect every single one unless you have a ton of money and spare time, or you own your own plane. 3. Vary the pokemon that appear from time to time, it's always the same ones you see. I still haven't even seen a bulbasaur, despite visiting forests and fields!

Love the game with all its little unexplained mysteries. It will make you spend, however. There's a suggestion I'd like to make. Could you make it possible to send friend requests through name instead of through trainer code? I've been playing this game for a week now, and although I've seen plenty of action and teamwork at Gyms and raids, I've got no friends yet. If friend requests are easier to send, you can add a block feature too, and I'm sure the game will be much more fun. Cheers!

So.... Firstly it's a great game and I love it as a long standing pokemon fan! It's so fun to play and great to get you out of the house more. You can also play WITHOUT having to make any online purchases which is fantastic as some games are almost impossible to play without spending real hard earned cash! It's really thought out , maybe a few lag issues here and there but I do have an older model phone and it still works really well. Overall, Great Job!

I play this game a lot but lately it hasn't been working for me properly, constantly freezes and kicks me off....I even got myself a new phone to play this game on to see if that was the problem only to find out it's even more difficult to play, can take about half an hour to even get it loaded and if I manage to catch anything it freezes and I have to reload again, my partner and myself encourage alot of raids through Facebook and when I get a chance to do a five star raid (17+people) it's freezes also and I can not participate, I'm so upset and I have done everything possible to make sure I have the right updates and a good phone and also great phone data only to find I'm spending most of my time loading and reloading, I have recently leveled up to 30....couldn't be more excited, can you guys help fix this issue

The game has changed from what it once was. That's not always a bad thing but in this instance this game has some poor and pay to win features. Collecting, raiding and catching Pokémon is fun. That core is always there and makes for a fun game. That said, the pricing of items with in the game do not make you feel like you are getting your money worth. Then there's the paid events that have also had major issues and their response to those issues have been poor. 2/10

Raids disconnect all the time or do not work correctly. Recently I used three remote raid passes, and after I completed the raid I got disconnected when I was going to capture the legendary Pokémon. Moreover, Niantic support said that after a "thorough" investigation I had already been compensated, which never happened. Please fix the connectivity issues while doing a raid, as I don't want to waste more money on in-game items that won't work.

Honestly, this game has become virtually unplayable recently. Each update brings more and more issues and errors. Crashing and freezing while trying to send gifts, lagging out after I've caught or evolved something meaning evolving with lucky egg is a no go, most recently it won't let me incubate eggs, constant errors during the current event such as not being able to log in for periods of time or pokemon vanishing when you click on them. Stop adding new stuff when you can't even fix existing errors!

Pokémon GO is a good way of spending time outdoors and discovering new things, monuments and important places and at the same time playing Pokémon. The Pokédex entries give you the feeling of completing something big, something you want to put effort in. It is sad that there is no way for you to play this without literally walking and going outside especially for those who live in small villages or towns where there aren't a lot of pokéstops or gyms (speaking from experience). Good game.

Edit. 22/04/2021. I've played Pokemon Go since the very beginning, and I must say it's the best free game out there. Yes I have purchased coins in the past, but if I'm honest, that was just me not being patient enough to earn the 50 coins per day! It doesn't use much data to play. And the games GPS is pretty good also. You do get occasional glitches and bugs but they're soon eradicated with updates. Great game.

Edited from 5 stars to 1 because of the latest update (April 2024) The "update" to the trainer models was a poor choice, not only are their proportions strange and a little uncanny valley/horror esque, it's almost impossible to get my trainer even close to her appearance when we still had the old (and more visually appealing) trainer models. Honestly considering uninstalling, because I don't want to play something or spend money on a game where my avatar is ugly and not what I want to look at.

A great Pokemon game that gets you out and about. In fact Pokemon fans have been waiting for this type of game for a while. The GPS can be a little awkward though which upsets the flow of the game. the growing Pokédex is brilliant and mini missions keep it interesting. New Let's Go implementation is a little confusing to set up but once it is, trading Pokémon to your Switch is a really nice touch and very useful.

I'm sick of how badly Niantic treats it's pokemon go players. Recently I have had a number of instances where a raid did not work due to a fault with the game. These were done using passes that I paid for with real money. When I tried to contact support, they send an automated message saying that after a 'thorough investigation' (which is a lie) that they found that everything went fine and they just close the ticket. They just don't care about the players but are happy to grab their money.

it's a fun and awesome game... if you live in a city. installed this a few months ago and just got so, so disappointed that they didn't put pokestops and gyms in rural areas. city people are packed with those but rural people like me can't enjoy the game really well. i understand that there's this nominating for a pokestop but I'm still at level 17 and it's a really long way before i get to 38 to finally be able to nominate. please do fix that, niantic. i don't wanna uninstall this game.

Upon updating my PokemonGo app to the latest version, the character was unable to walk, so I assume the GPS can't track my location properly (though my Location was set to High Accuracy and all of the configurations are set acvordingly). Considering this, I can't play the game smoothly and it affects may gaming experience. Today I'm running out of Pokeballs since I can't visit some Pokestops properly. Hope you can help me out. Thank you!

The new QoL updates are great. There is still some lag occurring in GBL, but it's definitely not as bad/constant as before. I rated this update 3* because my pokeball plus cannot be connected at all. Others have also complained that their gotcha cannot be found by the app. In the today view, could you also fix the coins earned for the day? It pops up occasionally if the pokemon is returned in that session, but if I close the app and open it again it disappears. Thanks

Deleted it, it became too tedious and was virtually useless when you don't live in a big city with people. I would love a way to open presents faster, it gets pretty tedious after the first 1000 times, it would be the greatest thing since the appraisal feature. Less popups would also be greatly appreciated and more egg variety, I'm getting sick of walking lots to get the same pokemon but I guess that's chance.

Although the gameplay is good, there are a couple of bugs. For example, today I had 850 storage spaces and 247 coins. I bought an extra 50 storage spaces for 200 coins. The coins get subtracted, and the animation of +50 storage spaces does show, but when I go to my storage, the spaces are not added. Simular bug for pokemon limit and other items from the shop.

In their PvP battles, multiple times the other player gets their charged attack a second after they just used one, making me lose shields. This is obviously a glitch they haven't done anything about and is VERY annoying, because it makes me lose multiple battles to something that isn't fair. Their customer support is also non existent; they just refer you to articles. I've spent over $40 on this game. What a shame.

All the things added that make the game more accessible they have removed. They are making it more difficult for people with various accessibility issues to play. The shortened community days, the remote raid passes being raised in price and being limited makes it difficult for many people to play. I've decided to give it up after playing since launch because of this. They clearly don't care about their consumer base.

Have not been able to play in over 24 hours.... I've gotten as far as the loading screen and then I'm kicked out again. I've done everything you can to try and fix this. I've uninstalled the app, cleared the cache and data, restarted my phone, and reinstalled a million times with no change whatsoever. The only way you can contact support is in side the actual game and that's not possible if none of us are able to get in the app..... how are we getting any support? Are the even checking these?

Makers seem to be doing all they can to frustrate players. If they want to shut down tracking sites the least they could do is fix the in-game tracking first. Nobody likes wandering aimlessly for hours not being able to tell if they're getting closer to a rare Pokemon or not. Also the levelling up thing seems so poorly thought out it's unbelievable, player levelling up and training Pokemon. Won't be spending any more on in app purchases until Niantic start listening to and communicating with fans.

Not a lot of fun to be found 'hunting' pokemon unless you use a 3rd party app in tandem. The lack of variety of pokemon being found is turning me off the game very quickly. Until niantic sort out the hacks, cheats and spoofing, especially when it comes to gyms, this game is essentially tedious, boring and broken and completely ruined for genuine players.

If you don't live in a city or active community, you won't get the most out of this game. I was having a lot of fun with Pokemon Go when I first started playing. But over the last year, Niantic has been making changes that have been hindering the enjoyment I used to feel. As a rural player, remote raiding is the only way to get legendary Pokemon and Niantic has now limited raiding and more than doubled the cost of the item needed for it. The game is becoming very unfriendly to players as of late

Much has improved over the last couple of years. pvp, shiny/lucky 'mon, field/special research, raids, events... etc... still a long way to go than just button mashing but dev's are clearly focusing on the main aim of pokemon; battling 'mon against other trainers. Still plenty of bugs in game, eg; vanishing pokemon, caught pokemon changing, freezing, crashing, amongst others (don't get me started on adventure sync!!!) but a vast improvement and I'm happy playing again

For the most part, this game is great. It gets me and my kids out walking when the weather is nice. The gameplay is engaging. My only issue is the trading system, where we have 3-star Pokémon that you can evolve with a trade, and they are no longer 3-star after the trade. It's stupid and makes no sense. Anything less than 3 stars isn't worth keeping because the attack, defense, and hp stats are too low.

The game used to be fun and not so predatory, but it crashes often, freezes on loading, and prices have almost doubled for remote raids. Niantic could fix these issues but they refuse, instead introducing more buggy features like campfire and forcing players into in person raids, which unless you have a consistently playing close group of friends, will never happen. NO ONE goes to in person raids anymore.

Great game! I've been playing since it's release. New features are being added every now and then. And now with the pokestop submissions, we can add more stops/gyms on rural areas. The only downfall are the ingress players who approves the submissions thru OPR. They are less enthusiastic in approving stops or making a certain place a pokestop haven. Also, it would be cool if they could add skinhead avatars. :-)

Can you please give us an option to hide the "Raid Nearby!" and "X received Y items from your gift!" notifications? I'm can't connect my Go Plus, because the notifications cover the icon. I can't see my Pokemon's CP because the notifications block that. I cant's see how many coins I have, blocked by notifications. I'd like to open the app and start playing rather than opening the app and putting my phone down for 5 minutes once I agree to not trespass or play while driving...

I suggest that you should create a pokecenter in the game because not all the time we have potions, one thing is that potions are rare to get in stops, you could only a bunch of them when you leveled up but since it is not that easy to level up, our pokemon remain ill haha and remain unusable until we leveled up or find potions. I hope you read and think of this well.

There are some nice elements, and the developers are always working to add new elements to the gameplay. Also kudos for the social aspects and encouraging physical activity. However, the application itself isn't very robust - often just sitting there spinning as though it has no connectivity, even though the network is fine. This usually requires a restart to resolve, which quickly becomes annoying.

The lack of servers is astounding. This is a detriment to the Pokémon reputation. Error messages left and right. The only consistent thing is the game crashes. Thank you for ruining my favourite childhood TV Series and game. (2016) Edit: Three years later, the game runs super smooth. No errors or crashes encountered in three months of consistently using the software. Glad to see it has switched around.

Quite entertaining...when it works. The game is pretty good, but has a habit of kicking you out and not being able to reconnect to the server. The only solution I've found is to uninstall it completely and then reinstall. As this is getting old very quickly, (and the reason I stopped playing for over a year previously), I can't see me doing it much longer. This longstanding login issue needs to be fixed.

The game started out great - I've played since the very beginning - but recently there has been a clear developmental departure from the ethos of the game and pokemon, which included systematically inflating prices to disadvantage rural and disabled players. The majority of the enjoyable, community aspects of the initial game have been spoiled at this stage. For these reasons, I would hesitate to recommend the game to new players.

I'm extremely frustrated and disappointed. I accidentally pressed the sign out button and then I fully remember my password and username so I really thought it was okay. So I typed my password and username. BUT it kept telling me that it's unable to authenticate. Our wifi is pretty bad so I thought that's the case, but it wasn't. I've tried it multiple times, it's been four days now. I was definitely sure I entered the right password and username. But I also thought maybe it's wrong, so I tried to reset my password. And I did. After undergoing the procedures, I was able to change my password. So I went back to the game and inputted it. BUT it still says the same thing!
