I really love this game, but now my data is lost. If you can fix this problem, then I will be back and rate 5 stars for that.

Used to not get many issues with it but now it's a nightmare. The AR isn't working - screen just goes black and I can't go back, I have to close the app and reopen it. Also now it just keeps freezing when I do anything. Pokemon pop up around and if I click one the screen just goes white and freezes. It's being a super nightmare. Hope you guys get these glitches sorted out asap

Don't get into this game. Niantic just keeps making changes that negativily impact user experience and engagement. I've played this game since it came out, and despite the added features along the years that kept the game fresh and fun, all the recent changes since 2020 have been in the name of profit margins at the cost of quality of life for the player. It doesn't matter how much you've invested in this app, it will never be enough. Unistalled and may the whales feed this money black hole.

Broken update upon broken update. Late event activation upon late event activation. Niantic continue to fail to do the basics right. This game has been out for almost 5 years now, and the recent update has put the game into a near unplayable state with copious amounts of lag in the GBL, frame rate drops, freezes and more. If you are one of the lucky ones that didn't update (my device auto updated), do not update update until niantic acknowledges and fixes the problem.

Fix Routes and daily adventure incence Routes Auto Pause and Galarian birds don't even come after 50 tries. I have been trying strategies from going on routes to doing it at specific times to no avail. I still have 2 Master Balls in my bag not used. The in game purchases are crazy; $1.50 AUD for something you can get in 30 minutes. Terrible Game, Don't Download it. 👎👎👎

The game is quite good. Great development, however when getting inside to the (Ar mode) to catch some pokemon. It seems like to catch the pokemon, the phone needs to be near the eyes. Since if it is far, it is hard to catch, also the payment is a bug, since to get 100 pokecoins is 5000, while to get 550 is 75,000, the diffrence is so big. So that is why i give it as a 3 star..... 😭😭😭

I don't think I've ever played a game that the developers didn't want you to play this much. Niantic is constantly creating barriers to game play. Want to battle? Too bad, there's a limit to battles. Want to raid? Too bad, you need these limited passes. Want to revive your pokemon? Too bad, you need these limited coins. They constantly add new features that are more glitchy than they are fun or worthwhile. I want to love this game but Niantic apparently doesn't want me to play it. Disappointing.

It wont let me log in for days on end. Occasionally i get to uninstall it and reinstall and it'll work again, but it doesnt always fix it. Incredibly annoying when you're out and about I've tried contacting support multiple times for the past few months but noone ever replies. Very disappointed, i enjoy the game but it literally won't let me play it.

Its a good game. Adventure sync got me playing it again, but it doesn't always work. Also, as of late, every time I've loaded the game for the past few weeks, I've had the same 'GPS Signal not found' error, and just so you know, my location is turned on. Not sure if my device is incompatible, or if the GPS signal is just buggy 100% of the time. I can still battle and do the other non-gps signal related things. Sometimes spontaneously crashes, but I put that down to my phone, and not the game.

I love Pokémon over all and love the idea of being able to go out and find pokemons but the one thing that makes me lose interest is that you can't customize your character to look like you. There's only 1 haircut and 1 eye shape. To get more clothing options you have to pay money. Even with the amount of time this is out it was never updated.

With the amount of time and energy users are required to spend on this app I seriously think the developers need to take a step back and rethink almost the whole game. The battle interface is utterly terrible, no matter what you do, the game decides who wins. If you look at a the current games for Mobile, PokémonGo still has a very, very, very far way to go. Stop urging people to make in-app purchases and start fixing your ridiculous excuse for a Pokémon Game.

I have been frustrated after playing this game. It's a very time consuming game.Takes lots of time to login. I have to try 5-6 time for login. Because of it's worst server it takes a lots of time to authenticate. After lots of hardworking while I got some Pokemon then the server stopped working and I have been logged out from the game automatically and the problem persists after the updation also. It's a really frustrating game.

Spent an awful long time on a Field Research Quest for a Lapras since I didn't have one. Finally finished the Quest, clicked on it, made an Excellent Throw and all of the sudden it cuts me out - both the Field Research Quest and the Lapras are nowhere to be found - both gone! This isn't the first time it happens to me, sometimes it cuts me out from gyms, battles, Pokémon that I'm trying to catch because an error pops up (both my 4G & GPS are completely fine at those moments). Very frustrating!!

I install it and I can open it and make an account fine. Then the game starts. All good, right? Nope! Charmander, Squirtle, and Bulbasaur glitch into one character, and I can't catch them. There is no way for me to catch them. I have spent the last two days trying to solve this, but it's just a bug that can't be fixed for me, unfortunately. Don't waste time installing. Until this bug is fixed my star rating remains as is.

It's one of the worst behaving apps I've ever tried. It gets stuck, it hangs, it's crashes whenever there's less than perfect network conditions or GPS reception. It's slow, has inaccurate controls, lags... as no other application however bad was made that I tried. The game story is good and seems to improve over time but implementation is terrible. Sorry :(

Lately there's been a bug with Android users unable to continue their game without logging out and back in again. Can try closing as reopening, trying again and again, But only thing that works this far is to log out and back in. If you typo your password (at least 8 letters, capitals, lowercase, and a symbol!)then you can't log in until you force the app closed due to authro problems. It's really annoying and taxing. Keep hoping this gets fixed but it doesn't. It's infuriating. Each time you log out Judy so you can log in so you can play..., your app forgets your sound settings. You log out out and back in the game and the app will destroys your ears. I don't even understand how that's an oversight.. Please allow the app to remember settings. Either way. Not Enjoying having to log in 30 times a day.. I have battery saver off, sturdier permissions given to the app to keep it open, why does it have to keep closing the moment I go to another app?

After sometime playing, i will tell you what is missing in this game: in-game map STRANGER trainer's APPEARANCE! and an in-game list of nearby stranger trainers! Let us find each other in the game map, we can introduce our self in that not through a web so if a trainer we don't know pop up nearby(display in map), we can tap each other and make friends! a lot of players just don't go through webs to find Pokémon-go friends you know, do this so we can approach nearby future friends!

Overall, I have had fun playing the app, but recent company decisions have prompted this low review. After numerous failed launches of events, as well as the continued refusal to address long-standing issues with the game (such as with battling), and the now the sharply increased prices of shop items, I have to rate the app poorly. It is obvious that Niantic only cares about profit, not quality of game play or player experience, as is evidenced by them blatantly ignoring player feedback.

Been playing on-and-off since 2016, and it's finally fully playable for rural players, with newer game additions alloweing for spawns to your location. Being able to battle other trainers remotely is cool too, so hopefully they can do the same with trades. My favourite addition has to be the remote raids, so I hope they make remote passes more accessible.

Brilliant game nowadays! Hotspots seem to of disappeared and pokémon seem to be more random and only influenced by weather (shame not by location either e.g. fight types by local fitness gyms). Only other criticism would be raid battles are just too hard solo either by health or time, and it's hard to find gyms where other people are ready for the raid at the same time (basically only good if you got pokémon go buddies with you). It should adjust the difficulty accordingly to player count.

Please sort whatever is stopping S20 users from playing!! We're missing out on everything you're doing to help us during lockdown :( I'd also suggest some way to prevent wasting items when your bag is full, either selling them for coins to use in the shop, or using them for gifts instead- being able to customise gifts with it would be cool! And it can be randomised to prevent bias i.e. people giving certain friends all their best stuff. It'd be a lot more helpful!

Uninstalled, the game gets worse and more expensive every day, they seem to keep taking things away because God forbid you have too much fun. There's also many annoying QoL things they could easily change, for example, the freind and raid notifications you get Pop up at the top of the screen and get in the way of other buttons so I need to wait for the notification to go away and sending and receiving gifts is tedious and more - a game has never made me hate a set of devs so much. Disappointing.

There's been a lot of issues popping up for a while now, even before the go fest. But now after the recent update I can't even play where I am or even if I go outside. The game with acts as if I'm commiting taboo, character lags behind even for miles on end when I'm already far away from where the game thinks I am or it never finds my location. It also sometimes makes it impossible to catch raid or shadow Pokemon since the textures get all messed up as if the were from Minecraft.

The good: It's fun to collect all the pokemon, It's great to be outdoors and explore, doing raids with friends is enjoyable. The bad: Battles are childishly simplistic with few moves and teams of only 3, CP caps are arbitrary, Atk, def, and spd stats are poorly explained, stardust takes an obscenely long time to collect, even with active bonuses, the game is extremely grindy, & the whale fishing microtransaction store. Overall: Play for the collection aspect. Nothing else is very substantial.

An enjoyable timesink, even if a little grind-ey, and neat way to play a Pokémon game. However, the most recent patch forces you to always have your GPS on and location known to the game in order for your steps to be counted whilst the app is closed (a large part of the game when it comes to hatching eggs and earning candy.) Why this was implemented I have no idea as it used to be perfectly fine by using the step counter built into the phone. Until this is reverted I have deleted the game.

Hello guys, I do can feel a great experience playing it. But, it sometimes gonna struck. And one of my friends cannot recieve daily free boxes. Also, it would be great, if some of my near places are made poke stops and poke gyms. Other than this, the game is marvellous. Also, try to increase ways in getting pokecoins. I hope u do respect my words. And take care of this problems. Thank you.

Little update on my old review. Was 3, now 2. There's been an uprising in errors for myself and a friend, who can't even access the app anymore. The shop doesn't work. I have to open the app 4 or 5 times to properly play the game without it saying 'try again later' for a few minutes at most. I feel like there should be a lot more Pokestops/gyms, or a daily bonus we can get, unlike the free shop items each day. Please sort out the errors most of all.

Love getting back out and about again after my interest in Ingress lapsed, but ugh, this app is horrendous. If you can actually log in at all it constantly freezes when capturing Pokemon, the gyms don't load or kick you out as soon as the battle starts and the tracking system is useless. I'd say we should've expected better but it IS a Niantic product after all. D-

Excellent game, have played it since release. Yes there have been bugs and what not but still a great game. Only reason for 4 stars is that the Pokémon go plus notification is not there anymore when it's connected which is a real pain and even though they say you can now swipe to remove the in game notifications s it doesn't work. Hopefully this will be fixed in the next update

The gameplay is fantastic, but I spend more time trying to get into my account than actually playing the game. Whenever I try to start it on mobile data it says "Failed to log in". Also it's full of bugs and cannot be used in the kind of place where you won't crash into people all the time because there isn't data in that place. Don't install, it'll only frustrate you.

Thank you so much about creating this game for I'am a pokemon fan. I gave the game 4 stars because I think there are still missing features specifically about chatting. For instance, it is more fun to just chat another friend in this app and it is also great if there is a worldwide chat where players can talk to each other. Also it is more convenient to see the trainer code below the name. it is useful if my friend wants to be his/her friend. Thank you so much and I hope you'll think about it.

Niantic is reverting some positive changes they had promised to keep, like increased gym/stop interaction distance. This is a huge let down for everyone, especially us who've been playing regularly for years. Old review: Occasional visual bugs, sometimes I need to reinstall or clear cache/data, but overall it's a great game and I love participating in raids and trades with my local community.

With all of the latest content updates this is by far the best AR game around. There's plenty to do if you're willing to walk for it! Battling, trading, collecting; it's all finally in the game, to make this the most realistic pokemon simulator out there. You don't have to spend any money to play and the upcoming online league and leaderboards make this game a must have.

Really enjoy the game but I hate the change they have made to the landscape colours. Living in Scotland it rains a lot. When I play and its raining the whole landscape is a depressing grey colour which is factually incorrect. All around me are lush green trees, bushes and grass. Quite the opposite to how it is reflected in Pokeman go, don't like playing therefore when it rains. Doesn't leave much playing time therefore. Hope the developers look at their depressing colour pallet.

Pokémon Go; more commonly known by it's customer base as "walking around aimlessly to find what may or may not be near by," or "look another Drowsy, " or "ugh, my GPS signal is not working again." It is absurd to have made such an obscene amount of money off of your customers and still have so many insufferable bugs. This idea was great but is quickly fading because of your absolutely horrendous support (or lack thereof).

Overall the game is addicting with consrant events so you always have something to do, what I think could be a helpful feature is a chat log with friends, it has it's pros & cons but it would make joining raids, trading, battling and communicating alot easier since invites have a time limit and sometimes you can't join in time or you don't get the notification at all, other than that the game is amazing, definitely recommend.

I was always a big fan of this game. Been playing since 2016 with minor breaks, but the last couple updates show, that Niantic does not give a flying F about the players or their opinions. I was very happy to spend money on this game, cause it felt like i could get some value for my buck. But not anymore, im not gonna spend a single € ... thank you Niantic for building one of my favorite games, and then destroying it with overmonetization.

I used to have my rating as 5 star but my experience has gone downhill a lot over the last 1-2 years. It has become more of a pay to play game with so much more micro transactions involved now. Also they are rising the price of everything in the store so it either takes you a lot longer to buy things or you need to pay more to have it

This game relies heavily on tracking your gps location (for hatching eggs or collecting candies) and yet the gps is inaccurate and awful. You can walk 15km and the game will say you've walked only a fraction of that. Very difficult to advance in the game without expending more energy, data and battery life than necessary. It's frustrating and takes away from the fun experience of gaming. With proper updates I think it would be better.

I used to play this on my old iPhone 5c before it stopped being able to update due to that model being outdated. Now I have an android and was so excited to get the game again, and everything was going well, until I had to actually catch a pokemon. Basically, despite allowing access to location services, the GPS doesn't work in game, so I can't play it at all. All my other apps work fine with location services, and uninstalling and reinstalling the app hasn't helped, nor has any other attempt.

Used to be a fun game. Now it's just full of bugs, synchroadventure not working, getting kicked out of remote raids, no response from niantic support (still waiting for an issue reported 3 months ago), slot of errors when trying to catch Pokémon, eggs hatching only one pokemon all the time, events les entertaining, the list just goes on and on.

This is an arranged game, especially for sending pokemon to Pokemon Home. Easy catches for starter allow you to send them to whatever game needed, this is brilliant when trying to do the Pokedex, so the game has it's ups and downs, what one person might need it for others might want to for different stuff especially when travelling to find alternative pokemon. Given this game, 3 out of 5 rating as I think it could have more features. Cheers for reading!

Price changes and quality of life keep going in the wrong direction. The developers should be creating more ways to include people, not make it more difficult for us to play. Keeping a community happy and investing in them pays off with long-term success rather than trying to squeeze out short-term gains. Pokémon go already makes it difficult to access much of its content and people have chosen to invest in it. However, the game doesn't get more challenging, it just keeps getting more expensive.

Glitching from the moment I opening the newly installed app. The game will not activate to allow me to catch the starter pokemon. The character just stands there and does nothing so I cannot begin to play the game, it froze many more times in the opening story parts of the game. The game is far worse than it was when it first came out. Was really looking forward to playing it on my new phone which has far more memory and processing power than my last one yet I cannot get the app to work at all.

Niantic's customer service to paying customers is pathetic. I got double billed for a purchase that I made through a bug. All attempt to contact Niantic redirected me to contact them through the in game support. I attempted to the do this, but the app crashes. When I did get through, Niatic refused to refund this double bill. It's go to know that's when you need help in this game, Niatic won't be there. My lesson is not spend money with the app at all, and save the disapointment.

Game Devs have no interest in bettering the game, and will make the game more difficult, and inaccessible intermittently. Update: Still making the game worse. Update 2: Costs have increased from 2-4x for various items and services, promised features are limited compared to the past, and most promises are broken in one way or another. Update 3: Costs have gone up again, with no features or benefits to compensate.

Very addictive game. No wonder it bloomed in the community when it first ce out. The only things that ruined the gameplay for me is the catch mechanics. It is just so frustrating when that slight little flick will send the ball flying to who knows what. And the catch rate that I had to deal with some pokemon is just Ridiculous. As an example, I tried to catch a Caterpie with a great ball the other day, it didn't even take one cycle for it to get out. A fricking Caterpie!

Don't start playing this game. This should be one of the greatest mobile games of all time, but Niantic has over monetized and under delivered at every opportunity. They stumbled upon the golden goose and have been making incompetent attempts to kill it for almost three years. The latest of their bumblings has been a predatory price increase in remote raid passes. The past three years have been awash with terrible decisions that shows utter contempt for the game's players. I should stop playing.

Initially I enjoyed it greatly, but it gets stale very quick. No long term goals other than "catching them all". More aspects from the GBA game series should be incorporated, stats, moves etc.. Turning real life locations like schools/hospitals into their game counterparts, Gyms/Pokemon Centers. A better interaction mode with your pokes/buddies, tomagochi style.

The loading time just to get into the game is too long and the catch rate is a struggle even though have plenty of PokeBalls and when the spawn rate of a shiny Pokemon, as well as trying to complete quests just to finish them is a outrage, let alone the price of the stuff in the shop is a bit pricey...other than that it's a fun game and enjoy it while working

This game is nicely balanced in that you can play it seriously and build a team of awesome Pokémon to battle with, or you can dip in every so often to add to your collection, or anything in between. It's constantly being updated and expanded, and for a game that's designed to get you out in the world they've done a great job of dealing with lockdowns and keeping it playable. Plus it's free with no adverts, and you can easily play without buying anything if you want. It's awesome :)

original 5 star review: this game is amazing. I have met so many people out in the world playing it. I have never seen anything like this. absolutely amazing. not without its faults, I looks forward to updates that add trading and battles and for the bugs to be worked out. . . UPDATED REVIEW: still come back to this from time to time. it's a classic Game and it's not a skateboarding game.

Game is good but the developer seems determined to ruin it for players. The amount of time and money I invested seems totally wasted now. I've played it since the very start but if I knew then what I know now... My advice? Don't bother downloading it. Hyper exclusive, for able bodied players who live in a large urban environment, with plenty of time on their hands and are lucky enough to have an active local group. If you don't fall into ALL the above categories don't bother, you are excluded

*UPDATED- WORKING ON NEW DEVICE* Phone not rooted, running correct OS. Been playing since UK launch, worked on my device previously but suddenly not compatible. Was already battling issue of only being able to sign on over WiFi not data, so when out of Wifi range & the game invariably glitches, freezes, throws me off the server I then can't login unless I go find a WiFi connection, which isn't always easy in a rural location. I'm wheelchair user too, which makes the game harder for me as it is.

It was a good game until they niantic started money grabbing, they up the price of in game purchases and then update the game avatars to look like a bunch of flat looking, colourless bots, they literally have the money to do so much more and yet they are downgrading not upgrading the gameplay, The acuracy when getting the catch circle perfect is so out and has been for a while now. Its just getting worse, the further up in levels you go the more they stop your account from encountering shinys.

I've decided today that if ANY task is time limited, I'm no longer interested. I don't care if it is only a dollar, or more likely more as Niantic seek to screw ever more money out of players. I'm not buying in. I was probably 100 metres short if hatching an egg, but didn't. Result the task finished before I'd had chance to finish. No fault of my own, I just have a life beyond Pokémon and had other things to do. I want tasks that I can complete in my own time. I'm no longer paying to fail.

It's a fun game that will give purpose to your walks. Has quite a few flaws, like the data usage or sometimes it doesn't allow you to login (bad connection?), but none keeps me from playing. Collecting Pokémons, trying to keep the best and when you find friends: trading the less brilliant. It has a nostalgic aspect for those who played the games in Game Boy like me. It's casual, entertaining, it has events that keep you walking on the streets for hours and it will make your friends whine because you're playing this instead of giving them attention. I recommend.

Not too shabby. Should have the option to add Pokestops at certain locations. To avoid an over abundance of them, have them come at a hefty price where communities can get together and purchase one. Extra money in your pockets. Have a website setup where people can create a funding pool for a specific area for a new stop. Just an idea.

I love this game and play it daily. There's a lot that can be better though. I get a lot of gps signal errors, which can be very frustrating, especially when waiting in the lobby for a battle. If I'm using a remote pass it's extra frustrating. I also wish the avatars were more customizable! There's a huge opportunity for Pokémon go to make some money but instead they come out with silly back packs or boring wrist watches. Let's get some new hairstyles, body types, etc.

NOT DISABILITY FRIENDLY, also I have loved this game and have been playing almost every day since its release, but the price increases are getting ridiculous. I was spending almost £10 every month just to have a somewhat good gaming experience, with the recent price hike it's looking more like £20 now. I'm lucky I live near a city though, if I was a rural player it would cost a fortune. It's clear now that this game is nothing more than a cash grab on niantics part.

The game: 5/5. The app: 0/5. An amazing concept, but extremely poorly coded. I've been playing since it launched and in all that time I don't believe I've *ever* got through an entire session without having to restart the app because of a freeze or crash. And even when it's not outright falling over, it's buggy as hell.

Update to my review. After nearly 9 years of playing the game my account was hacked, due to being a casual player I couldn't give them specific details like events I had done or clothing items I owned and they told me to just start again. I can still see my account via my partners friends list. I wouldn't recommend wasting your time.

I was player from the very beginning but then stopped for 2 years. Now that i am back I have to say it became much more fun and smooth! I only wish spawning would have a little bit more variety. Otherwise smooth game play, fun research and special events! Ps. I adore the way the current situation is handled and all the changes dev's are trying to make the game enjoyable even during these times.

The big problem with the game in its current form is that it includes none of the puzzle solving that made the original games great. The sole game mechanic is collecting Pokémon, every quest is just about collecting X number of Pokémon or using X number of berries or performing X number of great throws. The lack of variety leads to the game getting very repetitive very quickly and the introduction of new Pokémon to collect does nothing to assuage this.

I enjoy the collecting part of the game, but battling is a bit of a nightmare due to all the glitches and freezing. Really disappointed about the raise in price of remote raid passes, I live in a small town where there are very few players so raiding in person just doesn't happen. I will not be paying twice the amount for a remote pass so will have to just reduce the amount of raids I do.

One minute I'm playing and can close the game and reload the next I can't. Game will not load so I can not play it. The game loads on my son's phone but soon as I try it the loading gets half way and stops, it is very frustrating as one minute it's fine the next it says no. What gets me the most is that I can do 6 days in a row spinning and catching but then the game won't load on the 7th day so I loose out! I try log out and log in only for it to tell me it was unable to authenticate it and won't le me log in. I've also noticed no matter how much I write bad things not 1 person from the app has tried to help me!

Love the game...but I seriously hate that now you MUST point the camera around to see/find the Pokemons...i miss the old times..you could play both with and without pointing the camera around :(((( I'm not sure how to rate the game...love it and hate it at the same time... Played it so much but had to quit due to weak device for a long time... really wish we could pick if we want to use the old ways or not.

It's a great game for both Pokémon fans and newbies to the IP. It's fun to walk around, catch and shiny hunt. The situation around the pandemic got Niantic to move in several ways, both good and bad. They increased spawns in general, added the ability to raid remotely, adapted quests and challenges so players are mostly able to do them from home. With this however, Niantic got insanely greedy, requiring us to buy a new kind of raid pass and more and more content gets locked behind a paywall.

A few things that would greatly improve gameplay for me: 1) Better graphics. Like, seriously, our characters are walking on a rudely coloured map. There are green fields and roads and flat squares. In a 3d game. Come on. 2) Character customization. Let's give our chars a unique hairstyle, hair colour, face, height,... make us look less generic. 3) Pokemon fights. Let us have actual Pokemon fights instead of tapping, and a chance to battle NPCs or other players even if the own team is below 2000cp. Gyms at my place are completely impossible for a low level player. 4) See other nearby players in-game. Okay, maybe just noone in my city is playing Pokemon go anymore, but if there are and it's just a missing feature: Let me see their avatars if they are nearby. 5) Pokemon and pokestops in rural areas.

Great game but buggy, non working additions. There's a "new" ( out for about a month ) addition called routes where you have to follow a determined route created by another player. And there's 1 of the issues, there are absolutely 0 routes for me and for the majority of the player base. AND if there are routes, then they don't work, they pause for no reason and then keeps getting you to walk backwards and forwards until you've had enough and just cancel it. Otherwise the game is great and fun.

Great game but getting tired of server troubles, unknown errors, unable to log in warnings etc. Definitely would not spend money on this. Update: still quite repetitive but added more events and larger catalogue of pokemon to obtain. Still alot of grinding required to beat certain goals and level up but common amongst a lot of free to play games.

There are too many bugs, crashes, glitches etc. This is not yet a completed application. Fix it! 3 years later its still incomplete, buggy, grindy, regional. Impossible to make progress if you play alone in areas where the game is dead. They took a great brand and franchise with huge potential and ruined it.

I love playing Pokemon Go since its first release, and as much as I always wanted to stay, I am always quitting the game due to location issue. Tried to fix my phone/s, modify my gps and improve it. But still the location services is not accurate and I am jumping on a location near my current location even if I am not moving! Please fix this so that I can return on the game and enjoy it once more.

This game has so much potential, but as with many other companies it's clear that Niantic doesn't care about the players in the slightest. Everything is about the bottom line for them. They "graciously" gave us "bonuses" for the pandemic, which in reality were just improvements that made the game worth playing again. Now they're removing them all and proving that Niantic is completely blind to the changes that the pandemic made to the world. They don't want us to play- they want to make money.

I really enjoy this game, but for me it has one huge drawback. The lack of Pokémon and pokestops in rural areas. In order to play I have to get a lift or bus to the nearest city or town, which are about ten miles and twenty miles away respectively. I think it would help greatly if more Pokémon spawned in smaller villages and if there were pokestops at more churches/church ruins and maybe even the local airfield. I'd be a bit more of a serious player if I could just walk outside and head out along the foot paths finding Pokémon like a do in the city.

The latest versions have been much improved. The game is now smoother and more fun to play, especially with the additions of trading and friends. Only issues I'm currently having are occasional glitches with a Pokémon 'stuck' in a ball when signal drops, and some days when the GPS seems dodgier than others. Now we just need a breeding mechanic and some kind of friend locator ability :)

This game started out really well, despite the server issues. Needless to say since the game launched Niantic has made A LOT of money, and yet they still choose to change the game in ways which make the player spend more money to play. This is just obvious greed on their part. Nevermind the removal of tracking, they just want you waste all of your pokeballs on low level spawns and fork out your cash for more balls. 2 million dollars in game purchases wasn't enough for them...

one of the most popular games for IPhone and Android around by any margin. there are many glitches and issues that occur with every update but it's constantly being improved upon. They always add new Pokemon, raid battles field research and rewards for daily play and regular use. the downside is the game is quite repetitive and sometimes the game feels like you have to spend real money to upgrade and get items unless you regularly play it. definitely much better when the game was first released

Wanna know why 1 star rating cause it's too location dependent. I love where literally almost no one plays it . So if I want to play either i need to spoof or I need to change where I live like bruh not at all friendly for casual plays. It should have been a relaxing experience but instead it's searching for any one who plays or using multiple devices to play. The new Gmax update wasn't help in the slightest. Give something for us who play in remote areas too. Niantic too disappointing

I live in a rural area. Absolutely no pokestops, gyms or pokemon around my house. I'm relegated to playing on my breaks and lunch at work. I know they're constantly adding more stuff, but it still seems like 99.99% of those are in places that already have them, just adding more. A way to fast track additions for places that have NOTHING would really help and would bump this up to 5 stars IMO.

There was so much promise for this game. Why features like trading or battling aren't included is a mystery to me, then removing the ability to track down the ones you want? So now it's just walk around in heavily populated areas and wait till things appear or your eggs hatch. I'd hoped the game would get progressively better, not progressively worse...

This app is not for people in wheelchairs. or for people who can't get out of their house because of certain disease. Some people might say, they dont have to play, but they deserve to do everything, a normal does. Gotta say, I'm little disappointed. If only they had enabled the feature to roam within the app, and not by actually moving. Then it might get more players and more good ratings. Due to inability of providing in-app movement to catch pokemons, make this app less likeable now.

Never has a development team started with a great idea for a game and made continuous decisions to run it in the ground like Niantic have. Every single event and update adds more bugs and worse gameplay. Remote raids may be that final terrible decision that push people away. Take it from a 7 year player who's quitting, this game isn't worth it for the Pokémon name.

This game is really good and engaging. Quite addictive also. You don't have to spend money to keep on in this game as compared to others. But, i feel this game is lacking a chat system. I mean we sure can add others players in friend list but there's no way to communicate with them in game. All you can do is to send them gift, trade and battle. For which they have to live near you. They should add some features so, we can play and have fun with players all around the world.

Very pathetic . When I started game it looked bit disappointing, the graphics are bad , it's looks like some imatures made this game. Nothing is perfect. Graphics are at worst , the characters of this game are not to good . When your pokeballs are over , you won't get anything . In other games when any of essential things are over you can get it next day or after 24hours. Overall my experience was very bad.

It is a good game when it works and when it's fair. I.e. good concept but not for everybody, not because they wouldn't like the game but because they can't play it where they live. That's the problem: it is one of the most unfair games there is; pay to win, bugs only affect some people, location changes everything. It's also really buggy, with frequent major problems as well as constant small new bugs occurring everywhere. This game can also be really fun to play though, just got some problems.

The updates are great, quality great. But the native refresh rate is like forced to turn on. Like it is turned off but the game is smooth. And i think its not healthy, my phone gets heated like 10 minutes of playing and battery drains faster event native refresh rate is off. Niantic, please fix this issue. I want to play outside, i live in a tropical country, and my phone heats easily. It feels like im playing inside an oven while holding freshly cooked potato

Good game. Enjoy it. Helps get out for a walk. Been playing for years. Some issues, special research tasks stuck if not completed in time. Sometimes can take over a year then to complete. Log in get notification "walked 6.4km with adventure sync since last log in" yet the 5km egg I put in an incubator right after I logged in only at 4.9km?!

What's not to like about the idea behind it? You go catching pokemon outside. It gives gamers an excuse to actually get some exercise. What I don't like (and why I haven't given 5 stars) is because it drains your battery horrendously quickly and the servers crash a lot. I expect the server issue is just a teething problem though as nobody could have expected this level of popularity

Niantic is the worst mobile developer company. Based on that you can expect bugs, lags, crashes, missed deadlines, broken mechanics and so on. There's a list of bugs (and I'm not talking about bug-type pokemon) that has like 500 of them, and some of them are dating back to 2016. Imagine a developer that can't fix a bug that is 6 years old? You can't? It's Niantic. The only reason this game is still alive and kicking is because it has "Pokemon" name attached to it.

One complaint with the new stay indoors update and the double pokestop distance I still can't spin then it just says out of range or try again later. My items aren't full and it's not just me having this issue. Also in this event when discarding items you should be able to sell them even if there's a limit to how many coins you can get per day or you only get 1 coin per item other than that good game

I have been going around in circles for several months with support about the game constantly asking me to sign-in, having GPS issues, and constantly asking me to allow my location. All of my setting both in-game and device allow complete location/GPS all the time! They tell me to "delete and download the app" and "check your settings" over and over. Pathetic support! Several months this has been going on. Now the game shows GPS error all the time. Will take your money, but not actually help...

Ever since the latest update around September 24th I ha e been having terrible GPS issues! I have been booted out of raids because all of a sudden I am running all over the place. I also keep having issues battling at gyms and get an error code "29" that states the gym battle has already been won, when I'm only at the start or in the middle. I have tried uninstalling & reinstalling several times!!! This is extremely frustrating . Please fix these glitches Niantic

I spent quite a long while registering my account because i couldn't log in my previous account. Then when i opened the app. It keep on saying i need to catch a Pokemon but where the pokeball? It didn't appear. And also said cannot detect my location. But i had opened my GPS and can even use it for Uber app. So nothing wrong with my GPS. I give up! Wasted one hour of my time.

Been playing on and off since 2016. I always end up coming back to it because it's a great incentive to stay active. I used to think this was a 5 star game but there's just more and more features being added that require more and more grinding, especially when it comes to evolving pokemon. Great incentive for staying active but just not that fun anymore.

Played since launch. Now I launch the game on rare occasions. Same bugs for years, raising prices and lowering item value and counts, and locking things behind special events with a pay wall. What gives? You've been raking in mad profits for years, but want more for less and can't be bothered to actually improve things? I used to enjoy this game and promote it among family and friends, now I really can't be bothered. You had a golden goose, and now you've foolishly decided to slaughter it.

Recent updates have made the game incredibly laggy and unstable. Playing on a Note9, engaging Pokemon is choppy, trying to give my partner crashes the game, and the game force stops IV scanner apps. I appreciate all of Niantic's work, especially in the midst of COVID-19, but this needs to be fixed. I still think the game is great, but it's in major need of a fix!

You know, if you guys made pokemon less pay to win, (give remote) raid passes for free, actually no, just make raids open to everyone. Potions also make it a constant thing in spins, and max potions to be specifi, the game would'nt have died out so quickly. In fact, you would probably have at least three times the activity of players. It's that we don't want to play, it's just it cost nothing to play other games which are just as good if not better.

I think we all know about the horrendous avatar customisations but this review isn't about that. After the latest "bug fixing" the game is unplayable. Every single time I try to throw a ball it flies off into the distance, doesn't matter what I do, if it's a curve or not, if it's a far throw or not, doesn't matter. The balls just leave the Earth's atmosphere. If it was a glitch that made our lives easier or somehow made things cheaper, it would've been fixed in minutes. Hope we get a fix soon.

So much of the game is based on FOMO that I couldn't keep going. Ironic, since this game basically cured my agoraphobia. Other than that, the game is very cool. The community that I've interacted with has been very positive and fun. I feel like a lot of the ticking clock mechanics introduced make it less enjoyable, but that may be an individual preference.

Really fun game, however the performance isn't great (acceptable on newer phones, unplayable on older ones) and the combat feels really unsatisfying. I don't know why they haven't made the combat like in any other pokemon game, (turn based) this tap-to-attack style combat is really badly made and by no means a good addition to this game. I also think that shinys should be really rare like they've been in older gens but there's a ton of events in this game which makes them rather common here.

Quite a few bugs have been fixed over the years. The game is what you make it, you can still level up and catch many Pokemon without spending money or lots of time. It's a shame that the raid battles require you to make Pokemon Go friends, so for this reason they get 4 stars, as you can't actually Catch Them All, without P.Go friends. Love the game very addictive. I mainly love this game because to exercise as well as having fun catching Pokémon. I wish it wouldn't use so much internet but eh. Overall, love the game. The game is really fun and as a long time pokemon fan I highly recommend it. However, I am unable to give it a score higher than 3 as it is impossible to progress in the game without pokeballs, an item which is not accessible to everyone as pokestops are not distributed properly with places like America having hundreds in just one city while more rural areas having none in sight. Features like gyms run into the same issue limiting players to fully enjoy the game.

Niantic has been pushing monetization a lot lately. And until recently they have not released any new "tangible" content asside from rare shinies and exclusive moves on old legendaries. Downloaded this game just over a year ago, am still completely hooked. I play daily, and have walked over 2000km playing in a year. Great game, and can be completely free (in app purchases are not essential to completing that game in any way). The game has massively improved since it was first released, and has far more for.players to do each day.

FOR THOSE STARTING OUT: if your tutorial Pokémon are stuck on top of each other on your trainer avatar, turn GPS on. You need it to play anyway! -- I've been enjoying this game, with some caveats. Interface is inefficient, badly designed, and many features are never explained in the game (I only found out by reading elsewhere). Needs ways to communicate with other trainers (short messages at least), even an option to see them in game if they're nearby. Very fun, even soloing, but not optimal.

Trainer Battles sucks! me (Android) and another player (iOS) were side by side, connected in the same WiFi network and I had a HUGE delay in the game, so much that he has defeated my three Pokemons and I was still seeing my first Pokemon half full and a message to choose about using some shield movement or not. Connecting in different networks didn't changed anything or this horrible experience, even after 4 trials in a row... I still got the same HUGE delay...

A fun game run by a company that cares more about selling location data than their players. It seems like Niantic has no problems removing quality of life features and running events full of bugs and issues. Every week they find a new way to disappoint, and I'm tired of it. My advice would be to never pick up this game in the first place, I spent too much time on it and regret my commitment to Pokemon Go when the the company doesn't care about its players.

Nice game, but a lot of improvements can still be made, especially regarding the connectivity problems, gps-signal problems, login/logout/server problems. Google fit does register it though, would be nice if it would sync to Pokémon Go the moment you're connected again (not everyone who plays pokemon go has a mobile subscription/large data pack).

Niantic is telling us directly that we're not producing enough location data for them. They do not care about the gameplay experience. They don't give two darns about making a good game and they've been testing the limits on what the player base will accept for years now.

I've been playing this game for a while now. But there's always one thing that bugs my gameplay, the constant lag is seriously annoying me alot. A nice blast from the past with the original pokemon but what is initially fun becomes tedious and repetitive after the nostalgia wears off and the thin and shallow gameplay mechanics surface. Verdict: Fun for a few days until the initial charm wears off, you'll find yourself more frustrated than charmed after a while.

Ever since lockdown ended, Niantic have been taking away the things they added during it, and then some, making the game much more inaccessible for those with full time jobs, those who are disabled, those who live in rural areas, etc. The game is in an awful state right now, often failing to load properly, and with players being alienated by the developers more and more with each update. Don't let it being a Pokémon game fool you. Do not download this game until Niantic sort themselves out.

Not that bad, not that good either. Bug happens occasionally but doesn't impact the game experience that much. I don't even know why I still play. The game is flawed over and over again. This whole train with a full party idea just made all the gyms in my town level 10 permanently. Addictive and frustrating in equal measures. Collecting is addictive, the PvP element is great (still needs some work, though) and the Ex-Raid system is often frustrating. It's easier and a lot more enjoyable to play if you live in a city. Community Days, quests, solo raiding, special raid days, events, festivals...it's all good. It's even more fun when you're playing with your friends or local community. Unfortunately, I had to drop this game due to lack of progression. At the end of the day, it's all about catching Pokemons over and over again. What I meant to say is that its gameplay is basically nonexistent and it can get boring over time. They do not allow to delete my Pokemon go account easily. Deletion request submitted months ago & multiple times. No response & no use. Better not to get started with these kinds of games. The revert to interaction distance is one of the worst decisions they could have made, doesn't make any sense, doesn't make people go out more, but instead want to stay inside and not play at all. It's okay, but sometimes there are bugs, that are really annoying like the one I am getting "Cant authenticate player". This game does really want you to buy things tho which I think is too much, you have to buy boxes incubators, and poke coins, your pokémon space will soon run out and you will have to buy more spaces, but 50 spaces for 200 cions to much money and now its just getting boring, there are never such rare spawns like there used to be, everyone is just to OP now, too hard.

When you start, you are not notified to start your location. It took me some time to throw a Pokéball as I hadn't done this. I uninstalled the game last September because of the broken radar and other annoying gameplay bugs. Reinstalled it again recently and was happy to see the radar was at least working. There's still so much more than this game could be. Still missing basic stuff like PvP battles and player pokemon trading. Maybe also a game that doesn't drain the hell out of your battery too.

Increasing the remote raid pass price is the complete opposite of a better experience. It Keeps freezing after battles with team rocket or other players. Doesn't let you use charged attack when fully powered up. Takes a lot of data with frequent updates. After being invited to a raid and you've fought the Pokémon it freezes on the summary screen, it doesn't let you catch the Pokémon because you have to restart the game.

By all means, download and have a go if you have space - it's very heavy on internal storage. Have fun catching some basic Pokémon. Then delete. Don't even try and catch 'em all. It will get boring quickly, and you'll end up using up a lot of Pokeballs catching same old, same old. You'll do plenty of walking, sure, but you'll do it with your nose glued to your phone. Better off going for a hike. Look at nature.

There is an issue of network, everytime I go for battle it says "weak connection" even in a good speed network it shows "weak connection" it's the only reason I lost too many battles and navigation error is must and it shows until you close and open the app 1 or 2 time sometimes that also dosen't help. Although I am giving a one star review on this game, I would like to say that I personally love playing the game. I think it's a fantastic idea to make a game where part of the mechanics is to actually go out and do things in the real world to advance. The graphics are visually appealing especially compared to some mobile games, the gameplay is satisfying, and although microttansactions are a feature in the game they are not overly intrusive as you can still earn the exactly what you're paying for just at a somewhat slower rate depending on your ability to defend a gym. My problem however, comes from the lack of support for players being affected by bugs. For example, I have recently run into an issue where I had just gotten my ursaring back from defending a gym for my team. When i had received a notification that my pokemon had returned with fifty coins. Excitedly i opened the shop happy to finally get the bag upgrade I've wanted for the past while, only to noticed i received no coins what so ever. I then went to the "support page" of pokemon go to see if others had the same problem which as it seems, others have also not received the coins they were supposed to be given. At the bottom of the page when viewing the details of the bug the developers inadvertently called people making the claim liars by stating they could not recreate the bug themselves, and therefore because it didn't happen to them whole defending a gym it was impossible that it happened to anyone else. I then decided to report the bug myself, only wanting an answer to why the glitch had happened, rather than the coins only to notice that I needed to confirm that I accept that I am not going to receive a reply blfrom anyone. If any of the developers are reading my review than please do respond to this review, just to explain why the glitch occurred if there is any information as to why it happened. I would then gladly change my review to five stars, because I still do absolutely love playing pokemon go.

I've never had lag with previous updates but I do now, and its made catching and battling pretty much a hit and miss type issue. Honestly likely to avoid the game till its fixed. EDIT: Curveballs have also been totally and utterly ruined by this update.

Suggestion:  In-game Appraisal should have option for Simple and Advanced. Simple being verbal interpretation only (as it is now) and Advanced being numerical data for exact interpretation. I don't want to interpret what "decent", "strong", etc means. I want exact numerical figures for the 3 IVs :)  Overall, awesome game! Battle should be improved, but I know you already know that.

every so often I get signed out of my account and I cant sign back in. its gives me an error message saying unable to authenticate, my username and password hasn't changed either so I dont know what the problem is. this needs to be fixed. it happens too often (EDIT) It's been way over a week now since I emailed support regarding the trouble I've been experiencing, and I still haven't heard anything back. I'm so disappointed so I'm switching from 3 to 1 star rating. I'd give it a 0 if I could.

From first playing in 2018 and before pandemic seem to be the best times I've had on the app. Since then it's become a clear cash grab with microtransations almost becoming a necessity if you want to be a part of the community, especially if you live in a remote area. I want to keep using the app but the item limitations, item prices and daily coin limits are just not matching up and it's becoming a slog to play instead of fun anymore. Disappointed and frustrated at what used to be a good time.

Pokemon Go is an amazing app for all kinds of people from the outdoorsy to die hard fans of the series to those like myself using it as a tool to overcome anxiety and go outdoors more. I rate it 4/5 because it can be difficult to play without mobile data or unlimited WiFi (lagging, freezing, slow loadtimes, repeated errors make a few common annoyances) as well as the amount of storage space needed and difficulties downloading updates. Fully recommend to all, though be aware of above limitations.

First of all the game is fun when it works. However, that seems to be less and less the case. With the updates, the old server problems are back, and the game also crashes a lot more, making it nearly unplayable on slightly older devices. Half the time you are fighting some kind of technical issue, which really gets old quickly. And now they have stopped refunding coins if you have technical issues, which is just ridiculous. Avoid until they fix this. Update: they did not, today they were found lying again, and they will do nothing about it.

The game is just perfect! But it would have been better if it came with option to use it either with a joy stick or normal movement. I can't move here and there all the time to play this game. So, if you can, provide an inbuilt joy stick for movements and after it, providing bikes for fast travelling would be great which we would control with the given joystick. Try it and believe me this wonderful game would get millions of more users.

The game started off with plenty of potential for greatness, just as long as the servers were fixed along with a few small bugs. Within probably a week, the main element of the game (a tracker for actually being able to find the pokemon) was broken. Now another two weeks on, instead of fixing it, they remove it completely and take down any third party sites which were around to fix the issue of the tracker not working. Not worth playing without a tracker!

This game is awesome if you need an excuse to go outside or struggle with that due to mental health problems. I do have problems with the purchasing items with real money though. Once I try to purchase something, it always fails and the item I tried to purchase will always disappear forever. Purchasing items is optional though, which is a relief. The occasional shiny Pokemon are always exiting, even if it's a duplicate Starly.

Update: The focus on battling and the increased prices for some of the more fun aspects like remote raiding so I could play with friends in other states/countries means I almost never play anymore. Original: Even with the server issues this is a great game. Obviously no one could have planned for just how insanely popular this would be. It's an honest free to play that doesn't limit you if you don't spend real money and let's you fast track if you do. A great and fun app!

The changes introduced in the pandemic made the game better, and now not only have they rolled back in many of those changes, but their making the game less accessible by increasing the cost of remote raids and limiting them. As someone who has time constraints due to life and obligations, the remote passes made it possible for me to raid. I for one am going to be quiting the game, enough is enough, Niantic has ruined a good thing.

It's a lot better than it was, but there is still 0 consideration for rural players. If you don't live near a city center, you'll have a pretty boring time, and the raid boss feature will be more or less unplayable. Other than that, it's fun and a great way to get me out and exercising. New features are more regular now and are by and large pretty useful, it's like the developers actually care about the playerbase after 2 years of neglect. If this game now was the release version 2 years ago, it would be astonishing.

A fun game however, every time I try to log in, it says unable to authenticate, and I'll have to change my password. Itll work, then the next day, same thing, and I'll have to change it again. I've changed it so many times now, this needs to be fixed. I always type in my pass right but it keeps happening, please fix! Also, it also shows gps error 11 quite a lot, even when I'm somewhere with excellent connection..

PoGo has continued to improve and add some QoL features, gameplay, and social function, which help make it fun. It still sucks that if you pay for items you also have to pay for space to hold them, but they've opted for money over usability here. More automated/configurable features to manage pokes and inventory would be great, but they won't add them because they want you buying more storage! I look forward to upcoming social features.

Current review: Fun and improved so much. Play it with my son and we have very little issues with bugs etc. It is a good way to pass time =) 2016 review: A pointless game without tracking system, internal or 3rd party otherwise. Now nice, great and excellent throws don't even give extra exp..? Horrendous way to update a game without advance notice and also terrible gym system.

Fantastical magical experience. Really enjoy this game but recently the game has been randomly canceling out and going to my home screen while in the middle of a battle. Getting really bad now cuts out half way through battles, also freezes in raids and shadow stops. Update still having clitches have had to delete game and re download it again about 5 times now. Getting really sick of the game which is a shame because I have invested quite a bit of money and time, going to delete soon for good.

Really enjoy this game and have for 6 years. But as of the 6th of April, the game will not be played often or is uninstalled. Mainly due to a price increase that is almost double on selected instore items (remote passes), also limiting remote raids I feel is a step back. The game has changed since covid and niantic needs to embrace it, not change it. But I suppose making you get out and walk makes them money as they do sell the data collected. What's more important? Definitely not the user!

I only have trouble with the routes: they are not completed because I'm "missing meters" or something like that. But to me, it's the first game I ever got addicted to. The different approaches allow you to choose your goals (wether it's tasks, gyms, Pokédex, medals, battling, perfect-iv-pokemons, coins, shinies!) so it's never boring because there's always something you can pursue.

Been playing since release. A fun way to kill time when walking or taking transit...when it works. Unable to launch/log in more often than I can, which constantly kills my streaks. It never fails to pester me with notifications even though it won't let me play, though! Bought a Pokéball Plus on Boxing Day and haven't been able to try it yet.

The game is constantly getting better. Not fast, but constantly. It is still a bit of a grind, but with access to more Pokemon's, more gyms, more events, more everything, and the Adventure Sync feature to compensate for the app's crappy GPS, I have fun again. Having a Go Plus accessory also makes a large difference in quality of life, fun and access to more 'mons and options.

It is a fun game to play casually with friends and collect pokemon as if they are stickers, but if you like a more complex game that values the battling aspect of it and your connection with you pokemon, just stick to the games from the original franchise. I have played the game since it's beginning, with a few pauses. It was a simple but fun game. However, in the past few months the developers took a hard turn on the cash grabbing aspect of it. The only new mechanics are thought out with the specific purpose of taking money from you, bugs are endless and they do not bother to solve them (unless it gets in the way of them getting more money, of course). Another point that bothered me is that they have no late game content. A person who has been playing for 4 years will be able to accomplish the same as someone who has been in the game for a month, and that aspect got worse now with them making the pvp system a "participate and win", instead of having to actually be good at it to get to higher ranks.

Nice to play, except when it either randomly closes, randomly freezes, or randomly decides to reboot my phone, not to mention the heaps of bugs that have been here since launch. You'd think two years and millions in sales would be enough for a software company to fix their bugs, but I guess making a game properly is too much to ask. Everyone I know who're playing this have the same issues as me, so it's not an isolated case. Also, with all the millions in sales, you'd expect the servers to be somewhat decent, but no. Somehow they still haven't set up servers that can handle the amount of traffic from 10 million users, even though they have a concrete number of the peak amount of users to expect. TL;DR: Thanks Niantic, you've made a game with barely any gameplay and loads of bugs and performance issues that you haven't been able to fix after two years. EDIT: Also, why is the cheapest coin pack also the cheapest per coin? None of your actions make sense Niantic!

Used to be a great game; I've been playing since July 2016. Now it freezes randomly while playing, often more than once per session, and is necessary to restart to continue. It lags a lot. And with the reduction in remote raids plus the huge price increase for remote raid passes that can only be acquired by buying them, I am already looking for a new game to play.

I don't know how to contact support but since the recent update when a Pokémon appears my screen goes to black. my phone is newer and the update was on the 2nd and I updated my game yesterday so I'm guessing it's most likelythe update. ....please fix this

Potential, but not quite there. At first, it was very very buggy. Customer service was (is?) non-existent. Today, it's ok and I do enjoy playing from time to time. Problems with it are more of its technological choises. Before the adventure sync just wasn't working. Now it seems to be working, but it drains your phones battery very quickly. One app with background use with 6% battery in under 1,5h is not acceptable.

The game is good enough a bit pay to win of late, but I'd love to be able to get rid of stickers, I appreciate they don't take up space in the bag that doesn't mean I want to keep all of them though. I think it would be cool to offer a suggestion box. Also would have loved for that level 40 medal to have been not limited time, especially since covid restrictions have limited a number players ability to play.

this game is a waste of time and money, even if you are a die-hard pokemon fan. this company does not care at all about their player base, they care about tracking and selling your location data. i have played for 8 years, hoping it would get to a point where it was enjoyable. instead, it is paywalled, laggy, unrewarding and simply just a joke of a pokemon game.

This could be great, and aside from server issues it was, on launch. But since then the developer has seemingly been removing key gameplay features from the game, such as tracking via distance. If Niantic bring tracking back I might have reason again to head outside specifically to play, but as it stands this is now something I just peer at from my desk, as I've no hopes of finding anything deliberately. Edit: well, it now has a feature it should have had since launch; you now don't need the app open and active to track walking.

Uninstalling after 3 years of re-installing. I just noticed pay walled events getting more frequent and expensive as time goes by. Missing the simple times when PoGo just launched. Also, as new features get introduced, the interface gets a bit too laggy. Too many going on, I guess. So, yeah. I imagine the game's gonna be heavily pay walled in just a few years. But it was fun 'til it lasted.

*update* 13/09 after around 4 years of playing ive decided to take a break. The game is weighted so heavily around raids now that the only way to keep up is to spend cash on passes. Ive lost the love for playing. Niantic if you read this please think about putting in more challenges or story mode types quests that allow you unlock more passes. Its insane how much you have to spend to keep up! Not good in the current climate (Covid-19)

Really good game, but... I've been experiencing a lot of issues when it comes to network changes. Whether it is because of my phone losing connection because of bad signal or sometimes just connecting to a WiFi network, the game stops recognizing my account; even after trying to log in again it just won't work. I have to uninstall and reinstall it again every time this happens (about twice a week) Please fix this as soon as possible, it's kind of annoying.

This is a great AR game and a good challenging activity for a group of like minded friends. I would have kept my rating at 5, but for almost a year now I've watched as my game gets needlessly stuck at 75% loading in title screen Every. Single. Day. It will usually take about 4 force quits and reopen to get the app finally running. It's shameful that this is a known issue and for so long. Definitely should be addressed by now.

Love the game but today's update has broken it. The battle mode just doesn't work. At all. And if I manage to finally get into a battle my Pokémon just sits there unresponsive and dying. I've reinstalled and cleared cache still it doesn't work. It's not quite juddery. Constant freezing and crashing. It's suddenly unplayable at the moment. Note 9 with all latest updates.

Lots of crashes lately. I don't know what's going wrong lately but more often than not, I will get daily crashes and the app will get stuck on the initial load screen. Having to close it and re open to get it to work. It will also regularly crash when catching a Pokemon. I'll throw a ball, shakes say once or twice. Frozen. Did I catch it or not? It used to run fine with zero issues but these latest updates seem to have caused more harm than good. Will update my review when the game gets sorted.

It's a good game but I still have problems with it freezing. You do need WiFi or data to play this though. I do however wish there was an offline mode so I can get my steps done without the game freezing because I don't have Internet or extra data for it to use. It makes it very hard to hatch eggs when the program constantly freezes and then doesn't want to boot back up because there's no WiFi connection. The other suggestion I have is maybe have a way to input your steps when you open the game. I'm tired of it freezing every time it has no connection.

I've been playing this game for 5 years now and it's good fun for what it does. Best location based game. It will appeal most to collectors. The PVP side of things is not fun , it turns the turn-based strategy of main series pokemon battles into a real-time quick reaction game with lots of tapping. The game design of this bit feels like something that might have come out of the megadrive/SNES era, and not in a good way. Heavy "pay to win" to get shiny legendaries. Eggs are loot crates.

Games are supposed to be fun and enjoyable, by making Froakie impossible to catch in a timed research event has put me off this game. Other issues like region specific Pokémon... What percentage of your players can afford to travel the world.... Games are fun if a little challenging, but when they are literally impossible to complete, they are no longer fun, but instead depressing and soul destroying. :(

As a player from the very start, I'm still very much addicted to the game and I'm satisfied with all the new features Niantic added to the game throughout its existence. As a solo player I did think the raid system was very unfair, not expecting to get any of the Legendary types for a while, but the research system that was implemented a while ago ensures that players like me can also get Legendaries now. On top of that, the large variety of research goals adds a whole new level of addiction to the game and keeps it from becoming stale after almost two years now. Still my favourite app next to the Samsung Health app.

It's a really shallow game, and the combat is buggy. Not unplayable buggy, but it is unresponsive and lagging behind the server. On the other hand though, it's an excellent Pokémon catching game. It's not a bad game but personally, I just didn't see the appeal of having to go out exploring (because of work and school life). Furthermore, it's unplayable on public transport because of speed-locking. At least in Ingress you could time it, but here you can't, and that even biking or sprinting for awhile (minute or two) can still speed-lock you.

The game is great, fun to play, lots of Pokémon to catch and so many different features. However when you get to the battle system, I have noticed that when you're trying to click your charged move it doesn't work as quickly which sometimes results the other person being able to use there ability first despite the fact that you may have clicked it first, which can be really frustrating.

After so many years of playing this, or at least attempting to, I'm done. Absolutely done. It's no longer fun. There's no reward for the total grindfest it turns into. You can have every catch bonus, all manner of berries, and the best Pokeballs, but all of that is immaterial as you will end up spending 20 ultraballs and the Pokemon will still flee. The whole point of Pokemon is to be a fun collectathon. If you can't get the "collect" aspect right, then what's the point? Catching more Pidgeys!?

I won't comment on the game itself, it is what it is. But damn the technical side is atrocious. GPS location sucks, the game fails to log in at least a few times every week (sometimes for hours and when it does log in, it resets the damn annoying music to on, seriously!). Some animations slow the phone so much it's not even possible to throw a pokeball etc etc... Forcing updates at least once a week, usually when I'm out on mobile network. Considering it's the #1 grossing app, it's garbage.

Love this game and the continuous new events. It does a great job keeping me interested and getting me active. I've been outdoors a lot more in the last two months since being back on this game. Two issues: battery drain is better than three years ago but could be better; there are still glitches, especially annoying after I've caught something and the game freezes. I'm also very unhappy there's no customer service, for a game that people do pay money and spend a ton of money on!

Love this game but recently on this new update for some reason it can't detect my location. I keep getting the error 11 message for my location. It's very frustrating when I feel like playing and not even restarting the game makes it work. I try restarting it like 5 or 6 times and it still gives me the same error message. I've never had an issue before this

Had no end of GPS location not found errors, and I mean no end. Didn't matter if I turned on the permissions. Adventure sync had so many problems, eggs weren't hatching at one stage. Reported a problem and I never heard back off of anyone. That was two months ago...the app is a great concept. Honestly, I love Pokémon! So to have an app that has so many bugs and problems, it's honestly sometimes frustrating and a bit of a let down.

Really great game and very addicting. I've leveled up quick with tips from friends and other players. While it's true rural gamers aren't going to get it's full potential with limited stops & spotty signal, that doesn't mean the game is bad. A 5-10 min drive into a populated area with multiple stops is worth it if you don't want to spend money on the game. Furthermore, adding friends from different locations/regions is a great way to get items, eggs, etc. when both parties send gifts.

The game downloads to 100% but then gets stuck. Have re-downloaded couple of times on 4G unlimited connection but no help. It also doesn't work on Nexus tablet with 3G (in-compatible for unexplained reasons, Android version is higher than the requirement). *Edit: The game actually installed itself at some point after I had left it at 100% for 3 days.. it also installs fine on newer devices. Gameplay is fine, though repetitive.

I've been playing since launch. Good game but I'd like to be able to merge my new account with my old one. Changed my email and lost my old account, losing my steps, pokemon and level 30. I would also like the ability to play offline, this game eats a lot of data. It would be great if Niantic took away the passenger button or if clicked once it shouldn't pop up again! Otherwise I like what they are doing and this is much better then when it started.

Overall, I enjoy it but lately the controls have become randomly non-responsive. I can open and close menus, but game controls won't work. When it happens, I can't manipulate the map, throw pokéballs, or attack in battles. It only fixes when I close and re-open the app. This is a major problem in raids which I can't re-enter afterwards without using a new raid pass.

I want to love this game, but it freezes or doesn't work 80% of the time I try to play it on my new LG G4. I believe the servers cannot handle it, and honestly Niantic should have been more ready for this highly anticipated game. I paid money into it to support but i may not continue this exercise in futility. Update: I went back years later during pandemic, and its much better. Over the years they have improved things a lot.

The reason why i deleted this game is because of the lag, this game is awesome. You wont be able to find a game like this. Adventure, Strategy and more. I really want to enjoy this game, but it's currently mostly unplayable for me. Every time I move out of my home network I need to turn mock locations on and off.
