I think daily gifts would be good, and also something to do when you're not able to move.

I love Pokemon. Played all of them since Red and Blue. That said, this game is sadly still not so. They created a vast, beautiful framework, and a social experience unlike any other. But the problems overwhelm the attempt at a game. The battery drain is still murderous and leveling past 20 is also an impossibility for anyone that has responsibilities, but the game now has more options and attractions at least to keep the casual player entertained.

Okay, so the app takes forever to load anything and kicks me out at random. The game's been unplayable for like a year now and it gets worse with every update. Update came and I wish I could rate the app lower than a 1 star. All it is anymore is 2 minutes of being stuck on a single frame after the game loads, and then the game crashes. Absolutely horrendous.

The game is OK. It does everything you'd think it needs to do. But when you look at this game from the perspective of a pokemon fan, it feels like there are lots of missing features. The capture system is definitely the best part, but not being able to train a team by battling wild pokemon, and the boring battle system really make this feel like it's not pokemon. The combat is too straightforward, and boring. The trainer battles are basically a contest of who can mash harder.

Used to be good but it is now rubbish. When the adventure synch was working I used to get 50 k a lot as am a chef and walk a lot, but obviously can't do it with a phone in my hands. would be 5 Stars, but the recent update with remote friend trading has notifications going up every few seconds. please fix this. I've turned off all notifications for this game and still not working.

it seems that this App doesn't work with TracFone Blu View 5 phones. I tried to open the app and the Niantic logo shows up then the screen goes black. No load screen, nothing.

Not bad but a little buggy and some things are a little frustrating. Like when a pokemon is exceedingly difficult to catch and ends up having just decent or poor stats makes no sense. when you actually fix the issues that have been occuring for more than a year i will consider giving more stars and putting money into the game but as far as i am concern, i cant waste anymore time or data on the same issue over and over and over like customers havent been saying them.
I like the idea of the monthly go passes...but why do Pikachu and all the starters fight like their lives depend it it? I've had easier times catching LUGIA.

Game is back to something like it's best after a period where it seemed to lose its way. Plenty of content and activity. However I am concerned by the predatory aspects of the game, the increased reliance on incubators and other purchased items in order to have a chance of progression.

Great game, fully recommend for pokemon fans. You can buy storage eupgrades to hold up to 3500 pokemon (instead of the default which is a lot smaller). I used to love this game, and I still love Pokémon, but this game no longer supports the pokemon go plus catcher i bought when they first came out. and my adventure sync has not worked in several weeks, which is unfortunate because I average 15km+ walked everyday.

Having played it for 3+ months, I'm getting bored and disappointed with some elements of recent updates. At first, without the speed warning and limitation on clicking pokestops, I was hatching eggs and checking out items real fast. But now, you don't even allow us to check pokestops with a full bag. I can understand it as yet another measure of stopping cheaters, but then they can well use a new counter-measure by dropping items automatically to work around this. You don't end up stopping cheaters but you do discourage rule-abiding players. Many commuters used to check pokestops in bus or so - this is without any speed-related risk - and now this too is a good point of this game of the past. I do appreciate the recent addition of many spawn points and upcoming new features such as purported Ditto. But other than that, you guys really need to think of how to maintain the yuge revenue from us, which you won't want to miss, and how not to discourage die-hard, long-term fans. Your recent event of Lapras in Japan has effectively precluded Lapras from much of Asian places I know of, other than Japan alone. This is discouraging.

I know something is malfunctioning and I've cleaned my screen, tried another phone and restarted my phones without improvement. Please fix this issue.

It's a fun game, but takes so much grinding.. honestly wish they'd allow you to reuse some balls that just miss. I literally used 15 pokeballs for a single Apom... I ran away from it once thinking I was just wasting balls, he wouldn't go away so I tried again and STILL. Latest update pluses: more details of update contents, customisable avatars. Negatives: all clothing options now but still no way to filter them. It's a lot to scroll through! Please let us filter by style (eg short/long sleeves, shorts, trousers, costumes) and gender, will make things heaps easier

It logged me out and isn't letting me back in even if I put the right username and password. I would give it a better rating but when I was logged into the account still it would boot me out of the app and then close down, and on top of that I wouldn't be able to catch any Pokémon or evolve them full stop for NO reason. This game would be alot better of this could be fixed. I miss my Snorlax.

Not a bad game over all. the tracking system could be better and update quicker, pokemon could spawn near poke stops a lot more and battling needs to be more like the console games in my opinion, I also do not like the fact you only get 50 coins per day period especially when your pokemon have been in a gym more then a day I think niantic need to look into this and maybe change it.

The game is fun with a lot of features, but the routes don't work, which is incredibly frustrating. It's clunky to see the starting point, and all the routes say they can't be tracked online, and when you get there, it doesn't always recognise your arrival. When it does start the route, it pauses the route automatically, and when you see it, you're too far away from the pause point to unpause it. The distance tracker is also inaccurate, tracking about 1/3 of the actual distance travelled.

This game ain't no cap, wonderful developers, fabalous game. But I'd like to give it 4 stars just because I think the way we catch the Pokémon should be changed. I think you should add the real type battle. Like, we would battle with the wild Pokemon to catch it. Also, the battle is just clicking on the phone screen, so please make options for attacks in battles. Overall, the game is wonderful.

Hey, to everyone that's having that bug were you get stuck in AR mode with a full white screen, pretty much the game bugs out to anyone without camera access enabled. I had this problem, and re-enabled camera access in settings. When you enter a pokemon battle, you'll be given a prompt to accept the new updated AR mode or return to the standard screen for no AR mode. You click "maybe later" and your screen goes light blue. Close, reopen the app, and you'll be back to normal :) Fun game, and it's buggy and laggy at times, but it's free and the devs are trying their hardest, so it's understandable. Best of luck and please fix this bug soon. Best of luck!! :)

Every extra thing like gyms and raids just feel so unworth the effort. The pokemon available around seems to rarely change and then needing so much to evolve. Having to be right next to someone to trade and severely limiting trading is rubbish. Leaving your Pokemon in a gym its limited to 50 coins in total and you can't take them out. There just feels like there is no reason to put effort in because when you do its never worth it. The game has absolutely amazing potential and just botches it.

Awesome game! On the flip side it uses lot of battery, cpu and ram. I believe that you should improve the code to efficiently use the internal hardware. It feels clunky which equates to less efficient coding. I've played some high graphic intensive games and most run fast and does not slow down the phone. Other than that love the game 😉

Too many animations which are way too long. It's fun the first day, but it's pretty annoying to most of the player base. And they do nothing to address this. It crashes way to often, especially when doing raids with many people. Contacting support doesn't help in most cases, as rhey rarely reimburse you.

The game had it faults at first - not logging in every time, not locating you with GPS - A lot of the early problems have been dealt with and it is now an amazing game to play. A few more issues need looking at like the locating system of wild Pokemon but still I would recommend it as a great game and a good way to get out and get active

Don't let this rating fool u. I would've given this a 5* tbh , the game is good and delivers successfully (well , most of the time despite a few lags). However , getting wrecked all the time by players who aren't even in my area pisses me off. Players in the UK or something r getting into the Asian servers and raiding gyms and even placing their Pokemon here. While I have to walk a fair distance to reach the same gym , they could do it from their own rooms without moving an inch. That's lame.

After the last update I am loosing interest in this game. Unnecessary things r added. Route is worst thing which we get in this update. If you can't provide route then why added in games. There r no route near my location n I have travelled to different locations but none found. Slowely loosing interest might as well uninstall as I found it not at all fun anymore.

AR+ Please! A great, fun game that's nearly there. It's taken a long time but Niantic has nearly got the game into the state it should have been at launch - trading, battling and collecting. It's still a buggy mess mind you, but you learn to put up with the "quirks".

Would've been happy with just the old pokemon, and if there were more of them on the map. With the addition of new generation of pokemon, i lost all interest to catch anything. New ones look ugly. Want to go around catching stuff? Play Wizards Unite. Better graphics, sounds. Constant events. More things to catch on the map.

an excelleny game! fun... battery draining but fun. its not hard to get good but i have two problems i would like you to fix please. 1, my AR dosent work, it can't find where my phone is and i would really like to use it but it cant get the oriontation. 2, it really does not track movements well- this is minor but you really should make the character run more smoothly. thanx for the great game! a happy consumer.

Battle league is ruining the game. Unbelievably glitchy and no matter how fast you are or what player you're up against you can guarantee every single time (and that really isn't an exaggeration) they get their charged attack off before you which is mega unrealistic. Other than that the game is fine (rural areas do need more stops and gym for those who don't often venture in to cities) but battle really needs fixing, massively frustrating!

Good game but the recent change to Mystery box has messed up my ability to get Meltans. 3 days ago I activated it and the Meltan appeared for less than half a second. Wasnt able to click them let alone catch any. Today I activated it and not one appeared for 30 mins. Filed a bug report. Also this app rips through your battery.

frequent freezing during battles & catching. odds when catching are bad imo. NOT f2p friendly. you can try the gym, but it's hard if you're low lvl/have no teammates near. i know the game encourages players to go out & make new friends, but covid. some new stops and gyms are also oddly placed. many missions won't be completed because it needs to add new friends. & remote passes aren't cheap. an ok game at best, but more eh and pay to play.

It was difficult to get myself and my kids signed up initially. One of my kids wound up having to use my Facebook account in order to create a character. You definitely want to go to a place where there are lots of pokestops in one area, or you're going to be spending way more than this game is worth on Poke' balls. I initially started my family on this to get out of the house, but we just can't go for a walk without paying $15 on balls, so we hardly play unless we're driving somewhere.

Used to love Pokemon GO and would play it nearly daily, but the recent increase in price for remote passes and the limitation of remote raids has made it impossible for me to continue. I live in a rural town with no real community, so we barely get any raids here, and playing remotely was the only way I could actually keep up with other players who live in cities. Super disappointing from Niantic.

The game is great...when it's not plagued with bugs. I don't know what's been going on, but since December, their technical team has had 0 interest in resolving issues they introduce. 5 weeks to resolve an AR+ issue crashing my S10+ and now Shared AR+ is crashing it. Support offers apologies and no information. My advice: DO NOT SPEND REAL MONEY IN GAME. The way things have been, they don't deserve your dollars.

mostly a pretty bad game. the "gameplay" if you can call it that is dull, shallow and repetitive. throw ball, catch or maybe not catch pokemon, repeat. the community events ran often are frankly, pointless and a mess, events are literally a couple of hours long and occur in the middle of the day. the entire game is totally aimed towards playing in groups, by just simply locking features out completely if youre a solo player. this game should be avoided it needs lots of work, that it wont get.

Really badly coded with poor optimisation that slows down the whole experience to a frustrating crawl even when you've already downloaded the full client. I don't mind a server that's struggling for a few hours under heavy load but the servers are always struggling so it's sometimes a 2 hour wait before you can even interact with anything or for the menus to load up. They get enough money from people around the world so yhey buy new servers and invest in better coding!

Had some enjoyable moments and satisfied my collectors mentality for a while. May come back to this game sometime, but I'm uninstalling for now since the constant 'Unfortunately Pokemon Go has stopped' notification I keep getting while I've not even initiated the damn game for months has put me right off. And that's despite me having disabled those notifications ... Wow, Magic. As I type this another pop-up. YES! I KNOW IT HAS STOPPED! IN FACT I NEVER STARTED IT! UNINSTALLING THIS NIGHTMARE!

Recently started to have issues logging in. I have not forgotten my password or my username. I tried all of the troubleshooting options. If I can't login after that, I'm finished. I've spent a lot of money on this app and I'm pretty pissed off.

The game is great and the updates during lockdown have been exceptional. The only issue is I am not near any pokestops and there is 1 gym in view, so if there is a 3 star raid or higher it's impossible for me to complete as there is nobody I can do the raid with and the lower raids arent worth doing as its common pokemon spawning from them.

So you start with 350 item slots in your bag , you'd think that that's good until you hit lvl 9 and have no more room to fit anything useful for progression, its total items of 350 not 350 item slots, this makes playing the game very frustrating early on, please increase the default storage space, make items slot categorized instead of total counted items or give us an option to earn coins otherwise the game isn't even worth playing let alone spend money on

Before I downloaded this, I started seeing all of my friends suddenly finding new interest in the 2016 game, posting pictures of their pokemon. I had tried before to download it, but now, I finally understand what's so addictive about it. Pretty much every day we go out on a family walk, and I always bring my phone. One thing I can suggest is that Niantic adds a 'Staying at home' feature in the settings, so people who might be high risk can still enjoy pokemon without risking their lives.

Has trouble being accurate with your GPS movement and sometimes counts only half the distance you travel toward distance based goals. Few bugs here and there and sometimes disconnects you without telling, making you confused until you restart the app. Aside from the aforementioned issues this game is absolutely gold, it helps me move and exercise, explore outside in places I would never go normaly and see sceneries I've missed out on. It has also helped greatly to deal with social anxiety.

The Developers have turned abusive, severely changed the core mechanics of the game that make it less accessible for everyone. I like the game but due to PVP lags, bugs, and crashes, I'm done with its PVP. If there were 0 stars for this, I would opt to rate it 0. Niantic is not doing a good job fixing these bugs AT ALL... I was purchasing in-app items here but now I'm not buying anything to a game that is seemingly in BETA version... 👎

If you're a Pokémon fan, this is such a positive way of getting out into the world and catching them like you could've only dreamt about 20 years ago. Although this game does strip some of the core Pokémon series fundementals away, it's still probably the most authentic Pokémon experience that we're ever going to get that allows you to interact with the world and with your friends.

First time this was release, it was a real hype and unfortunately the hype is decreasing in time, but then new features were added, and lately.. The most interesting of Pokemon Go is how to collect the whole pokemon & exploring different places in the world, earlier version is better than last updates... we need trackers to find Pokémon... the speed notification is disturbing I can't play it when jogging anymore... there's a lot trainer cheating with fake GPS but no action from the developer.. thanks for ruins the most important thing of game there's no joy to play this game anymore. Somethings wrong with my game, A few days back, I couldn't check on my buddy, I forgot the reason why, and a few days later, the game wouldn't open at all, I have excellent wifi too, and I have no idea what is going on, Also, many people call this game dead so add something thats guaranteed to catch peoples attention, the mega evo is good, team rocket balloon is good but, there could be something missing, I spent 2 minutes thinking of an idea but nothing came out😥

Since I heard this game was going to come out in 2016 about 2 years ago(was it 2 or 1?) Pokémon fan for 20+ years, played this since day one as well. GENERALLY glitches are fixed in a timely manner, but then several more pop up with the next update. I've seen a few that have affected accounts for months on end.

Just make the incense work normally like it used to. As we're older we do not have the time to complete tasks such as raids, let alone collect Pokemon. Just make incense work without having to move. I also risk getting my phone snatched every time I walk out to play, looking down staring at the screen and ignoring the environment. And if quests are not completed during the season, I'd have to wait 16 whole months to complete it as those Pokemon wouldn't spawn again. Games useless without paying.

Ive been playing since the game came out, but recently, Adventure sync is just not working. for example, I walked 2.5 miles this morning, but it only logged 0.1 of 1k walked. With my lifestyle, I usually walk at very least 50k a week(sometimes up to 170!) and now it barely registers.it defeats the object of the game when u can't walk to hatch or hit targets. checking/restarting the app and it's settings does nothing.

I love this game but the support is awful. I've been contacting about an issue I had for days and only get the same bot responses. A few days ago I was browsing the avatar fashion items when, as I was turning my character I mistakingly swiped over the purchase button purchasing an item I did not want (the game has no "are you sure you want to purchase?" option). This item cost me 150 pokecoins and as a f2p player who works full time and cherishes every pokecoin I get, I want them back!

I love this game. My only problems are that due to living in a rural area, the level 5 raids are extremely difficult, the lack of pokestops makes completing certain tasks nearly impossible without traveling a minimum of 45 minutes, and the difficulty of catching the new pokemon due to low spawns.

There is the potential for a rewarding and fun game here, but balance issues, a deceptive sightings system and too much random chance make the game more of a grind than fun. With winter here and no reasonable way to hatch eggs (the only way to reliably get different pokemon, particularly powerful ones), I don't see myself playing much longer as the game currently is.

As always this Amateurism to develop the game that can never optimize. And now it will cut off access to devices with 32-bit architecture in the middle of a pandemic. Respected games have in the configuration options the light, medium and heavy level related to their graphics and resources. Bugs, glitches, lags, problems, paying a go fest ticket to just spend 8 hours completely frustrated in misery all day long, balls not throwing properly, gift not sending not opening, friend list not available, it's a nightmare for the nerves this go fest! Good game so far. Entertaining and interesting. The only problem that has occurred is the fact that the new avatar is so goddamn ugly. If the player feels like grinding the game, the game quite literally keeps you on your feet, but a lazier person can also play the game and still have fun (although it might be more difficult to gain stuff that way.) Anyway, I would recommend.

I find this rating getting lower and lower as time passed. With the over-simplified battle style, there really is no point in introducing the megas as raids or even in the game. This game is primarily about catching the Pokémon in the world, so leave the battle gimmicks to the other games. In addition, many of the latest updates are actually making it more difficult for myself to even load the game. I have to load it twice each time as it gets stuck at 50%!

Once again, I was convinced to play this as we are more or less forced to with the new pokemon games coming. If this is not reverted nor improved anytime soon I'll have to drop this game as I'm starting to feel repelled each time I open it up and see that abomination of a character staring blankly at me.

Went into a raid battle and my pokemon weren't moving, they we just stuck in animation. Wasted a good remote raid pass and 100 pokecoins when the game didn't work properly. Other than that the game is good, would be nice not to see the same pokémon over and over again because I seem to catch the same thing everyday. But apart from the frustration of wasting items I can't get back...it's fine.

I think this game would get a big hit if it had a joystick to move rather than walking in real life. And not only me I believe that a lot of gamer don't like this feature.

Pokémon Go is possibly one of my all time favorite games. I enjoyed the aspect of actually having to go outside and walk around to find Pokémon and poké stops.. there where a few minor problems like sometimes the poké stops not loading or having to tap on the pokémon multiple times before it would actually let you start to catch it. Those problems aside I thought it was a great game and will continue to play as a loyal pokémon fan :)

Game has come a long way but in ways of compensation for things that happened due to bugs or anything out of your hand will always be a waste. Always expect to be under compensated and the same few responses from the support chat. The game in general is great. The support team gets a 1 star from me for the one time they may actually give you the answer youre looking for.

A Pokemon game that's close to its full potential now. Catching, hatching, trading, battles pve and pvp both - you can feel like a true Pokémon trainer. There are issues with GPS lag, bugs within pvp league, not enough trainer interaction options imho and other minor pains, but ultimately it's the closest you can get to be the very best (like no one ever was). Try it, if you haven't already. If you put it down some time ago, enough has changed about it that you might want to try again.

The game has some really annoying bugs, my least favourite of which is this new bug where half the letters and numbers on my screen will disappear. Pretty game, mainly featuring using your GPS as part of the gameplay. On the downside, it has far too many bugs, problems, etc. Various errors, multiple freezes a day requiring game restart, annoying bugs, that's all about the game. As a popular example: as part of COVID they made free PvP, well, turned out these are often unplayable (just search for "pokemon go weak connection" to understand why; and no, it's unrelated to connection). It is also terribly unoptimized: despite having a simplistic graphics game has far too many moments when it "loads" something. At first I was blaming unoptimized network usage — but no, for my gf with the same network but a newer phone these things load up much faster. That's when I figured, all these moments it indeed calculates something on my phone. To give you an example: friends list, there's nothing to process, really, it's just a menu with a few images, it gotta be instant! Well, turns out it depends on the phone. For an indirect evidence of being badly optimized: it is the most energy-hungry app I've seen so far. There's also a feature of trying to catch pokemon with your camera enabled, but without going into details, you'll most likely disable it quickly. For my gf on her brand new Xiaomi it was wrongly calculating environment, for me in turn pokemon seems not aware of it at all. The world map isn't the most correct one either. So, is it good? Well, for me it was fun to play first 30 hours I think, in part due to quests I have to complete. And I still using it for a friend who I have little other chance to make go out. Other than that, it quickly becomes boring, and the tons of bugs tend to make the game too annoying.

The gym battles are alright, and the raids are cool too, but good luck finding partners. My biggest gripe with the game is the go plus's inability to stay connected. It seems like you need to travel a significant distance in a certain direction before it even begins to count as distance. There's also no reason that the go plus shouldn't work while driving. It's a button on the wrist of a hand you have on the wheel. Pressing it is less distracting than changing the radio station. As of right now, the go plus is much too unreliable to make it worth purchasing and I'm considering returning it. Besides the disconnection issue and the fact that I can walk down the road and not register that last 0.1 km i need on an egg, it's a super fun game. Edit: my go plus disconnected while I was typing this review. Edit: it's been a couple of months and I feel this needs an update. Pokemon Go is awesome. It can link with Google fit, and tracks your steps that way, so egg hatching is actually based on how much you walk instead of some arbitrary gps movement. The Go plus still disconnects constantly, but its consistent now, down to the hour. Apparently this is to save battery. Regardless, the game is constantly improving.
